openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: 全场景智能自动化超级中枢
  version: 20.0.0-Complete-Unified
  description: |
    🚀 完全统一的单一智能自动化工具 - 深度整合所有功能模块
    ✅ 单一端点处理所有58项核心功能 | ✅ 智能路由决策 | ✅ 全链路监控
    ✅ 企业级稳定性 | ✅ 支持自然语言和参数化两种模式
    ✅ 支持用户选择是否启用自动化处理 | ✅ 无缝融合8大核心插件
  contact:
    name: 全场景智能自动化技术支持团队
    url: https://universal-automation.com
    email: support@universal-automation.com
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0 & 商业许可
    url: https://universal-automation.com/license
externalDocs:
  description: 全场景智能自动化引擎完整文档
  url: https://docs.universal-automation.com
servers:
  - url: https://api.universal-automation.com/v1
  - url: https://api.coze.com/v1
tags:
  - name: 统一智能自动化
    description: 单一工具处理所有自动化功能，支持58项核心操作
  - name: 系统监控
    description: 操作状态监控、健康检查和管理
  - name: 参数验证
    description: 参数验证和智能修复服务
  - name: 工作流管理
    description: 工作流生成、执行、优化全生命周期管理
  - name: 插件生态
    description: 插件生成、修复、部署和管理
  - name: 数据智能
    description: 数据增强、分析、训练和智能处理
  - name: 领域专业
    description: 行业分析、非遗保护和领域专业化处理
  - name: 系统运维
    description: 监控、健康检查、紧急情况处理

paths:
  /unified-automation:
    post:
      summary: 统一自动化执行端点
      description: |
        单一端点处理所有自动化功能，支持智能路由和自动参数处理
        
        💡 **使用模式选择**：
        - **简单模式**：使用自然语言描述需求，系统自动分析并执行
        - **专业模式**：使用结构化参数精确控制执行流程
        
        🔧 **自动化处理选项**：
        - `enable_automation=true`：系统自动完成参数补全、错误修复、智能路由
        - `enable_automation=false`：严格按照用户输入执行，需完整参数
      tags:
        - 统一智能自动化
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
        - ApiKeyAuth: []
        - CozeAPIKey: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SimpleUserRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProfessionalRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/CompleteUnifiedRequest'
            examples:
              简单模式:
                summary: 简单自然语言模式（推荐新手）
                value:
                  user_request: "帮我创建一个电商订单处理工作流，包含订单确认、库存检查、物流通知功能"
                  timeout: 300
                  enable_automation: true
                  preferred_action: "generate_workflow"
              专业模式:
                summary: 专业参数模式（推荐开发者）
                value:
                  operation_type: "generate_workflow"
                  operation_config:
                    workflow_config:
                      business_domain: "ecommerce"
                      complexity_level: "medium"
                      requirement_description: "生成电商订单自动发货工作流"
                    validation_config:
                      auto_validate: true
                      validation_strictness: "standard"
                  async_execution: false
                  version: "v3.0"
                  enable_automation: true
              完整模式:
                summary: 完整智能模式（高级用户）
                value:
                  operation_intent: "分析电商数据并生成智能工作流，自动修复节点问题"
                  operation_config:
                    business_domain: "ecommerce"
                    execution_mode: "auto"
                    priority: "high"
                    resource_allocation:
                      cpu_priority: "high"
                      memory_limit: "2GB"
                      timeout_ms: 60000
                  smart_parameters:
                    auto_detect_plugins: true
                    auto_repair: true
                    error_masking: "partial"
                    validation_strictness: "standard"
                  enable_automation: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 同步操作成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedSuccessResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SuccessResponse'
              examples:
                工作流生成成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    execution_time: 2.5
                    result_data:
                      workflow_id: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                      workflow_name: "电商订单自动发货流程"
                      status: "created"
                    automation_applied: true
                数据处理成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_9e3f5d7c2b4a6e8d"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:21:00Z"
                    execution_time: 1.2
                    result:
                      data:
                        processed_items: 1500
                        quality_score: 0.95
                        enhanced_data: {}
                行业分析成功:
                  value:
                    code: 0
                    data:
                      analysis_result: {}
                      recommendations: ["优化供应链", "加强数字化"]
                    message: "行业分析完成"
        '202':
          description: 异步操作已接受
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncOperationResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncAcceptResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncResponse'
              examples:
                异步接受:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "accepted"
                    monitor_url: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    estimated_completion: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        '400':
          description: 参数验证失败
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponseWithFix'
              examples:
                参数错误:
                  value:
                    code: 4001
                    message: "参数验证失败"
                    errors:
                      - field: "parameters.demand"
                        message: "长度需大于10个字符"
                        value: "生成工作流"
                        suggestion: "请提供更详细的需求描述"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:22:00Z"
                    request_id: "req_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                带修复建议的错误:
                  value:
                    error_code: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
                    error_message: "参数验证失败"
                    fix_suggestions:
                      - "请提供完整的业务领域信息"
                      - "需求描述应至少包含10个字符"
                    auto_fix_applied: false
                    parameter_issues:
                      - parameter_name: "business_domain"
                        issue_type: "missing"
                        current_value: null
                        suggested_fix: "设置为'ecommerce'、'finance'等有效值"
        '500':
          description: 服务器内部错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponseWithRecovery'
              examples:
                服务器错误:
                  value:
                    error_code: "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR"
                    error_message: "处理请求时发生内部错误"
                    system_status: "degraded"
                    estimated_recovery_time: 60
                    recovery_actions:
                      - "正在重启受影响的服务"
                      - "检查数据库连接"

  /operations/{operation_id}:
    get:
      summary: 获取操作状态和结果
      description: 查询异步操作的执行状态、进度和最终结果
      tags:
        - 系统监控
      parameters:
        - name: operation_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 操作状态信息
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OperationStatus'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OperationStatusResponse'
              examples:
                处理中状态:
                  value:
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "processing"
                    progress: 75
                    created_at: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    updated_at: "2025-11-07T14:22:30Z"
                    estimated_remaining: 45.5
                完成状态:
                  value:
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "completed"
                    progress: 100
                    created_at: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    updated_at: "2025-11-07T14:24:00Z"
                    result:
                      workflow_id: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                      workflow_name: "电商订单自动发货流程"
        '404':
          description: 操作不存在
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /health:
    get:
      summary: 系统健康状态检查
      description: 检查系统各组件的健康状态和性能指标
      tags:
        - 系统监控
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 系统健康状态报告
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthCheckResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SystemStatusReport'
              examples:
                健康状态:
                  value:
                    status: "healthy"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    uptime: 86400
                    version: "20.0.0-Complete-Unified"
                    components:
                      database: "connected"
                      workflow_engine: "up"
                      ai_services: "up"
                      plugin_system: "up"
                    performance_metrics:
                      response_time: 125
                      throughput: 850
                      error_rate: 0.01
                系统状态报告:
                  value:
                    overall_status: "healthy"
                    component_status:
                      database: "up"
                      cache: "up"
                      queue: "up"
                    performance_metrics:
                      cpu_usage: 45
                      memory_usage: 60
                      disk_usage: 70
                    resource_utilization:
                      total_requests: 10000
                      success_rate: 99.8
                    recommendations:
                      - "建议增加缓存容量"
                      - "数据库连接池可优化"
        '503':
          description: 服务不可用
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponseWithRecovery'

  /validate:
    post:
      summary: 参数验证服务
      description: 验证操作参数的完整性和正确性，提供修复建议
      tags:
        - 参数验证
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 验证结果
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationResponse'
              examples:
                验证通过:
                  value:
                    valid: true
                    errors: []
                    warnings: []
                    suggestions: ["建议增加数据验证步骤", "推荐使用更高的分析深度"]
                    auto_fix_applied: false
                验证失败:
                  value:
                    valid: false
                    errors:
                      - field: "parameters.demand"
                        message: "长度需大于10个字符"
                        code: "LENGTH_TOO_SHORT"
                    warnings:
                      - field: "parameters.timeout"
                        message: "超时时间较短，建议至少300秒"
                    suggestions: ["请提供更详细的需求描述"]
                    auto_fix_applied: true

components:
  schemas:
    # ==================== 请求对象 ====================
    SimpleUserRequest:
      type: object
      description: 简单用户请求模式 - 使用自然语言描述需求
      properties:
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: 用户自然语言需求描述（系统自动分析并执行）
          minLength: 10
          maxLength: 2000
          example: "帮我创建一个电商订单处理工作流，包含订单确认、库存检查、物流通知功能"
        preferred_action:
          type: string
          description: 用户偏好的功能类型（可选）
          enum:
            - generate_workflow
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - process_luoyang_heritage
          example: generate_workflow
        timeout:
          type: integer
          description: 执行超时时间（10-3600秒）
          default: 300
          minimum: 10
          maximum: 3600
          example: 300
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true
          example: true
      required:
        - user_request

    ProfessionalRequest:
      type: object
      description: 专业请求模式 - 使用结构化参数精确控制
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UniversalRequest'
        - type: object
          properties:
            enable_automation:
              type: boolean
              description: 是否启用自动化处理
              default: true
              example: true
            timeout:
              type: integer
              description: 执行超时时间（秒）
              default: 300
              minimum: 10
              maximum: 3600

    CompleteUnifiedRequest:
      type: object
      description: 完整统一请求 - 支持智能参数和自动化处理
      properties:
        operation_intent:
          type: string
          description: 操作意图描述
          examples:
            - 分析电商数据并生成智能工作流
            - 修复所有插件节点配置错误
            - 洛阳非遗产品数字化处理和模型训练
          example: "分析电商数据并生成智能工作流"
        operation_config:
          type: object
          description: 操作配置
          properties:
            business_domain:
              type: string
              description: 业务领域
              enum:
                - ecommerce
                - industry
                - finance
                - healthcare
                - education
                - heritage
              example: ecommerce
            execution_mode:
              type: string
              description: 执行模式
              default: auto
              enum:
                - auto
                - manual
                - hybrid
              example: auto
            priority:
              type: string
              description: 优先级
              default: normal
              enum:
                - low
                - normal
                - high
                - critical
              example: high
            resource_allocation:
              type: object
              description: 资源分配配置
              properties:
                cpu_priority:
                  type: string
                  description: CPU优先级
                  default: medium
                  enum:
                    - low
                    - medium
                    - high
                  example: high
                memory_limit:
                  type: string
                  description: 内存限制
                  default: 1GB
                  example: 2GB
                timeout_ms:
                  type: integer
                  description: 超时时间（毫秒）
                  default: 30000
                  example: 60000
        smart_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 智能参数配置
          properties:
            auto_detect_plugins:
              type: boolean
              description: 自动检测插件
              default: true
              example: true
            auto_repair:
              type: boolean
              description: 自动修复
              default: true
              example: true
            error_masking:
              type: string
              description: 错误屏蔽级别
              default: partial
              enum:
                - none
                - partial
                - full
              example: partial
            validation_strictness:
              type: string
              description: 验证严格程度
              default: standard
              enum:
                - relaxed
                - standard
                - strict
              example: standard
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true
          example: true
      required:
        - operation_intent

    UniversalRequest:
      type: object
      description: 通用请求对象
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 要执行的操作类型
          enum:
            - activate_emergency
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - backup_revert
            - create_custom_node
            - create_workflow
            - delete_workflow
            - execute_workflow
            - feed_data
            - generate_workflow
            - get_data_connections
            - get_workflow_by_id
            - get_workflows
            - process_automation
            - process_luoyang_heritage
            - repair_all_nodes
            - train_model
            - trigger_auto_plugin_workflow
            - update_workflow
            - validate_parameters
          example: generate_workflow
        operation_config:
          type: object
          description: 操作配置参数
          properties:
            ai_enhancement_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AIEnhancementConfig'
            automation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AutomationConfig'
            backup_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BackupConfig'
            connection_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConnectionConfig'
            custom_node_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomNodeConfig'
            emergency_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmergencyConfig'
            heritage_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/HeritageConfig'
            industry_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/IndustryConfig'
            plugin_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PluginConfig'
            query_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryConfig'
            repair_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RepairConfig'
            training_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TrainingConfig'
            validation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationConfig'
            workflow_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig'
          additionalProperties: true
        async_execution:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否异步执行
          default: false
          example: false
        callback_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 异步回调URL
          example: "https://webhook.company.com/callback"
        version:
          type: string
          description: API版本
          default: v3.0
          enum:
            - v1.0
            - v2.0
            - v3.0
          example: v3.0
      required:
        - operation_type
        - operation_config

    UnifiedAutomationRequest:
      type: object
      description: 统一自动化请求
      properties:
        intent:
          type: string
          description: 操作意图描述
          example: "创建电商订单处理工作流"
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
          enum:
            - generate_workflow
            - execute_workflow
            - create_workflow
            - update_workflow
            - delete_workflow
            - get_workflows
            - get_workflow_by_id
            - generate_plugin
            - repair_nodes
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - activate_emergency
            - process_heritage
            - train_model
            - feed_data
            - create_custom_node
            - get_data_connections
            - validate_parameters
            - backup_revert
            - process_automation
          example: generate_workflow
        parameters:
          type: object
          description: 操作参数
          properties:
            activation_reason:
              type: string
              description: 激活原因
            analysis_type:
              type: string
              description: 分析类型
            async_execution:
              type: boolean
              description: 是否异步执行
              default: false
            auto_recovery:
              type: boolean
              description: 自动恢复
            auto_repair_level:
              type: string
              description: 自动修复级别
              enum:
                - basic
                - advanced
                - full
            business_domain:
              type: string
              description: 业务领域
              enum:
                - ecommerce
                - finance
                - healthcare
                - manufacturing
                - education
            callback_url:
              type: string
              format: uri
              description: 回调URL
            complexity_level:
              type: string
              description: 复杂度级别
              enum:
                - simple
                - medium
                - complex
            emergency_level:
              type: string
              description: 紧急级别
              enum:
                - low
                - medium
                - high
                - critical
            enhancement_type:
              type: string
              description: 增强类型
              enum:
                - cleaning
                - enrichment
                - transformation
            industry_name:
              type: string
              description: 行业名称
            input_data:
              type: object
              description: 输入数据
            plugin_type:
              type: string
              description: 插件类型
            repair_scope:
              type: string
              description: 修复范围
              enum:
                - config
                - logic
                - dependency
                - all
            requirement_description:
              type: string
              description: 需求描述
            user_demand:
              type: string
              description: 用户需求
            workflow_id:
              type: string
              description: 工作流ID
            workflow_name:
              type: string
              description: 工作流名称
        config:
          type: object
          description: 执行配置
          properties:
            priority:
              type: string
              description: 优先级
              default: normal
              enum:
                - low
                - normal
                - high
                - critical
            timeout:
              type: integer
              description: 超时时间（毫秒）
              default: 30000
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true
      required:
        - operation_type
        - intent

    ValidationRequest:
      type: object
      description: 参数验证请求
      properties:
        action:
          type: string
          description: 功能类型
          enum:
            - activate_emergency
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - backup_revert
            - create_custom_node
            - create_workflow
            - delete_workflow
            - execute_workflow
            - feed_data
            - generate_workflow
            - get_data_connections
            - get_workflow_by_id
            - get_workflows
            - process_automation
            - process_luoyang_heritage
            - repair_all_nodes
            - train_model
            - trigger_auto_plugin_workflow
            - update_workflow
          example: generate_workflow
        params_to_validate:
          type: object
          description: 要验证的参数
          example:
            demand: "生成简单工作流"
            industry: "电商"
        return_suggestions:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否返回建议
          default: true
          example: true
        validation_strictness:
          type: string
          description: 验证严格程度
          default: standard
          enum:
            - relaxed
            - standard
            - strict
          example: strict
      required:
        - action
        - params_to_validate

    # ==================== 响应对象 ====================
    UnifiedSuccessResponse:
      type: object
      description: 统一成功响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作是否成功
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 响应时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        execution_time:
          type: number
          description: 执行时间（秒）
          example: 2.5
        result_data:
          type: object
          description: 操作结果数据
          additionalProperties: true
        automation_applied:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否应用了自动化处理
          example: true
      required:
        - success
        - operation_id
        - timestamp

    SuccessResponse:
      type: object
      description: 简单成功响应
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
          description: 错误码（0表示成功）
          example: 0
        data:
          type: object
          description: 执行结果数据（JSON对象）
          example:
            name: "电商订单自动发货流程"
            status: "created"
            workflow_id: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        message:
          type: string
          description: 成功提示信息
          example: "操作成功"
      required:
        - code
        - data
        - message

    UnifiedAutomationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 统一自动化响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作是否成功
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
          example: "generate_workflow"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        execution_time:
          type: number
          description: 执行时间（秒）
          example: 2.5
        result:
          type: object
          description: 操作结果
          properties:
            analysis_result:
              type: object
              description: 分析结果
            coze_import_command:
              type: string
              description: Coze导入命令
            data:
              type: object
              description: 数据
            enhanced_data:
              type: object
              description: 增强后的数据
            message:
              type: string
              description: 消息
            plugin_id:
              type: string
              description: 插件ID
            plugin_name:
              type: string
              description: 插件名称
            processing_time:
              type: number
              description: 处理时间
            repair_report:
              type: object
              description: 修复报告
            repaired_nodes:
              type: integer
              description: 修复的节点数量
            workflow_definition:
              type: object
              description: 工作流定义
            workflow_id:
              type: string
              description: 工作流ID
      required:
        - success
        - operation_id
        - result

    CompleteUnifiedResponse:
      type: object
      description: 完整统一响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作是否成功
          example: true
        execution_id:
          type: string
          description: 执行ID
          example: "exec_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        execution_trace:
          type: object
          description: 执行追踪
          properties:
            operation_flow:
              type: array
              description: 操作流程
              items:
                type: object
            resource_usage:
              type: object
              description: 资源使用情况
        intelligent_insights:
          type: object
          description: 智能洞察
          properties:
            optimization_suggestions:
              type: array
              description: 优化建议
              items:
                type: string
            performance_metrics:
              type: object
              description: 性能指标
            predictive_analytics:
              type: object
              description: 预测分析
        operation_summary:
          type: object
          description: 操作摘要
          properties:
            execution_time_ms:
              type: number
              description: 执行时间（毫秒）
            successful_operations:
              type: integer
              description: 成功操作数
            total_operations:
              type: integer
              description: 总操作数
        results:
          type: object
          description: 操作结果
          properties:
            data_results:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataProcessingResult'
            domain_results:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DomainProcessingResult'
            plugin_results:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PluginOperationResult'
            workflow_results:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowOperationResult'

    AsyncOperationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 异步操作响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作是否成功接受
          default: true
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        status:
          type: string
          description: 操作状态
          enum:
            - accepted
          example: accepted
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL
          example: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        estimated_completion:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 预计完成时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 响应时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
      required:
        - success
        - operation_id
        - status
        - monitor_url
        - timestamp

    AsyncAcceptResponse:
      type: object
      description: 异步接受响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否成功接受
          default: true
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作ID
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        status:
          type: string
          description: 状态
          enum:
            - accepted
          example: accepted
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL
          example: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        estimated_completion:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 预计完成时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
      required:
        - success
        - operation_id
        - monitor_url
        - timestamp

    AsyncResponse:
      type: object
      description: 异步响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否成功
          example: true
        status:
          type: string
          description: 状态
          enum:
            - accepted
          example: accepted
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作ID
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL
          example: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        estimated_completion:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 预计完成时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"

    OperationStatus:
      type: object
      description: 操作状态信息
      properties:
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        status:
          type: string
          description: 操作状态
          enum:
            - pending
            - processing
            - completed
            - failed
            - cancelled
          example: processing
        progress:
          type: integer
          description: 执行进度（0-100）
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
          example: 75
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 创建时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 最后更新时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:22:30Z"
        estimated_remaining:
          type: number
          description: 预计剩余时间（秒）
          example: 45.5
        result:
          type: object
          description: 操作结果（仅当状态为completed时存在）
        error:
          type: object
          description: 错误信息（仅当状态为failed时存在）
      required:
        - operation_id
        - status
        - created_at

    OperationStatusResponse:
      type: object
      description: 操作状态响应
      properties:
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作ID
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        status:
          type: string
          description: 状态
          enum:
            - pending
            - processing
            - completed
            - failed
            - cancelled
          example: processing
        progress:
          type: integer
          description: 进度
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
          example: 75
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 创建时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 更新时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:22:30Z"
        estimated_remaining:
          type: number
          description: 预计剩余时间
          example: 45.5
        result:
          type: object
          description: 结果
          additionalProperties: true
        error:
          type: object
          description: 错误信息
          properties:
            error_code:
              type: string
              description: 错误代码
            error_message:
              type: string
              description: 错误信息
      required:
        - operation_id
        - status
        - created_at

    HealthCheckResponse:
      type: object
      description: 健康检查响应
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          description: 整体状态
          enum:
            - healthy
            - degraded
            - unhealthy
          example: healthy
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 检查时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        uptime:
          type: number
          description: 运行时间
          example: 86400
        version:
          type: string
          description: 版本
          example: "20.0.0-Complete-Unified"
        components:
          type: object
          description: 组件状态
          properties:
            database:
              type: string
              description: 数据库状态
              enum:
                - connected
                - disconnected
              example: connected
            workflow_engine:
              type: string
              description: 工作流引擎状态
              enum:
                - up
                - down
                - degraded
              example: up
            ai_services:
              type: string
              description: AI服务状态
              enum:
                - up
                - down
                - degraded
              example: up
      required:
        - status
        - timestamp

    SystemStatusReport:
      type: object
      description: 系统状态报告
      properties:
        overall_status:
          type: string
          description: 整体状态
          enum:
            - healthy
            - degraded
            - unhealthy
          example: healthy
        component_status:
          type: object
          description: 组件状态
        performance_metrics:
          type: object
          description: 性能指标
        recommendations:
          type: array
          description: 系统建议
          items:
            type: string
        resource_utilization:
          type: object
          description: 资源使用率

    ValidationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 参数验证响应
      properties:
        valid:
          type: boolean
          description: 参数是否有效
          example: true
        errors:
          type: array
          description: 验证错误列表
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
                description: 错误字段路径
              message:
                type: string
                description: 错误信息
              code:
                type: string
                description: 错误代码
          example: []
        warnings:
          type: array
          description: 警告信息列表
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
                description: 警告字段路径
              message:
                type: string
                description: 警告信息
          example: []
        suggestions:
          type: array
          description: 改进建议
          items:
            type: string
          example: ["建议增加数据验证步骤", "推荐使用更高的分析深度"]
        auto_fix_applied:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否应用了自动修复
          example: false
      required:
        - valid

    # ==================== 错误响应对象 ====================
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      description: 错误响应
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
          description: 错误码（4xx参数错，5xx服务错）
          example: 4001
        message:
          type: string
          description: 错误概要信息
          example: "参数验证失败"
        errors:
          type: array
          description: 错误详情列表
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
                description: 错误参数字段
                example: "parameters.demand"
              message:
                type: string
                description: 错误具体描述
                example: "长度需大于10个字符"
          example: []
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 错误发生时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:22:00Z"
        request_id:
          type: string
          description: 请求ID
          example: "req_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
      required:
        - code
        - message
        - errors

    ErrorResponseWithFix:
      type: object
      description: 带修复建议的错误响应
      properties:
        auto_fix_applied:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否已自动修复
          example: false
        error_code:
          type: string
          description: 错误代码
          example: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        error_message:
          type: string
          description: 错误信息
          example: "参数验证失败"
        fix_suggestions:
          type: array
          description: 修复建议
          items:
            type: string
          example: ["请提供更详细的需求描述"]
        parameter_issues:
          type: array
          description: 参数问题
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              current_value:
                type: string
                description: 当前值
              issue_type:
                type: string
                description: 问题类型
              parameter_name:
                type: string
                description: 参数名称
              suggested_fix:
                type: string
                description: 建议修复

    ErrorResponseWithRecovery:
      type: object
      description: 带恢复信息的错误响应
      properties:
        error_code:
          type: string
          description: 错误代码
          example: "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR"
        error_message:
          type: string
          description: 错误信息
          example: "处理请求时发生内部错误"
        estimated_recovery_time:
          type: integer
          description: 预计恢复时间（秒）
          example: 60
        recovery_actions:
          type: array
          description: 恢复操作
          items:
            type: string
          example: ["正在重启受影响的服务", "检查数据库连接"]
        system_status:
          type: string
          description: 系统状态
          example: "degraded"

    # ==================== 专业结果对象 ====================
    DataProcessingResult:
      type: object
      description: 数据处理结果
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
        processing_id:
          type: string
          description: 处理ID
        processed_data:
          type: object
          description: 处理后的数据
        enhancement_report:
          type: object
          description: 增强报告
        quality_metrics:
          type: object
          description: 质量指标

    DomainProcessingResult:
      type: object
      description: 领域处理结果
      properties:
        domain_type:
          type: string
          description: 领域类型
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
        processing_results:
          type: object
          description: 处理结果
        domain_insights:
          type: object
          description: 领域洞察
        recommendations:
          type: array
          description: 推荐建议
          items:
            type: string

    PluginOperationResult:
      type: object
      description: 插件操作结果
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
        plugin_id:
          type: string
          description: 插件ID
        deployment_status:
          type: string
          description: 部署状态
        result_data:
          type: object
          description: 结果数据
        coze_integration:
          type: object
          description: Coze集成信息

    WorkflowOperationResult:
      type: object
      description: 工作流操作结果
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
        workflow_id:
          type: string
          description: 工作流ID
        result_data:
          type: object
          description: 结果数据
        performance_metrics:
          type: object
          description: 性能指标
        validation_report:
          type: object
          description: 验证报告

    SystemOperationResult:
      type: object
      description: 系统操作结果
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作ID
        result_status:
          type: string
          description: 结果状态
        operation_details:
          type: object
          description: 操作详情
        affected_components:
          type: array
          description: 受影响组件
          items:
            type: string

    WorkflowBase:
      type: object
      description: 工作流基础信息
      properties:
        workflow_id:
          type: string
          description: 工作流ID
          pattern: '^wf_[0-9a-f]{16}$'
          example: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        name:
          type: string
          description: 工作流名称
          example: "电商订单自动发货流程"
        status:
          type: string
          description: 状态
          enum:
            - draft
            - active
            - disabled
            - deleted
          example: active
        create_time:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 创建时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"

    # ==================== 配置对象 ====================
    WorkflowConfig:
      type: object
      description: 工作流配置
      properties:
        business_domain:
          type: string
          description: 业务领域
          enum:
            - ecommerce
            - industry
            - programming
            - finance
            - healthcare
            - manufacturing
            - retail
            - education
          example: ecommerce
        complexity_level:
          type: string
          description: 复杂度级别
          enum:
            - simple
            - medium
            - complex
          example: medium
        requirement_description:
          type: string
          description: 需求描述
          example: "生成电商订单自动发货工作流"

    AIEnhancementConfig:
      type: object
      description: AI增强配置
      properties:
        enhancement_type:
          type: string
          description: 增强类型
          enum:
            - cleaning
            - enrichment
            - completion
            - quality_improvement
          example: enrichment
        input_data:
          type: string
          description: 输入数据
          example: "原始用户反馈数据..."

    AutomationConfig:
      type: object
      description: 自动化配置
      properties:
        operation_mode:
          type: string
          description: 操作模式
          enum:
            - industry_analysis
            - workflow_generation
            - auto_repair
            - luoyang_heritage
            - custom
          example: workflow_generation

    BackupConfig:
      type: object
      description: 备份配置
      properties:
        backup_id:
          type: string
          description: 备份ID
          example: "bak_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        revert_scope:
          type: string
          description: 恢复范围
          enum:
            - full
            - partial
            - data_only
          example: partial

    ConnectionConfig:
      type: object
      description: 连接配置
      properties:
        connection_type:
          type: string
          description: 连接类型
          enum:
            - all
            - database
            - api
            - file
            - streaming
          example: database

    CustomNodeConfig:
      type: object
      description: 自定义节点配置
      properties:
        node_type:
          type: string
          description: 节点类型
          enum:
            - code
            - plugin
            - metadata
          example: code
        programming_language:
          type: string
          description: 编程语言
          enum:
            - python
            - javascript
            - typescript
          example: python

    EmergencyConfig:
      type: object
      description: 紧急情况配置
      properties:
        activation_reason:
          type: string
          description: 激活原因
          example: "系统核心节点故障"
        auto_recovery:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否自动恢复
          example: true
        emergency_level:
          type: string
          description: 紧急级别
          enum:
            - low
            - medium
            - high
            - critical
          example: high

    HeritageConfig:
      type: object
      description: 文化遗产配置
      properties:
        action_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
          enum:
            - query
            - register
            - update
            - preserve
          example: preserve
        heritage_type:
          type: string
          description: 遗产类型
          enum:
            - intangible
            - tangible
            - cultural_practice
          example: intangible
        luoyang_heritage_id:
          type: string
          description: 洛阳遗产ID
          example: "heritage_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: 用户请求
          example: "数字化保存洛阳剪纸技艺"

    IndustryConfig:
      type: object
      description: 行业分析配置
      properties:
        analysis_depth:
          type: string
          description: 分析深度
          enum:
            - basic
            - standard
            - comprehensive
          example: comprehensive
        industry_type:
          type: string
          description: 行业类型
          enum:
            - manufacturing
            - retail
            - healthcare
            - finance
            - education
          example: retail
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: 用户请求
          example: "分析电商行业发展趋势"

    PluginConfig:
      type: object
      description: 插件配置
      properties:
        plugin_description:
          type: string
          description: 插件描述
          example: "订单处理插件"
        self_healing_enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自愈
          example: true

    QueryConfig:
      type: object
      description: 查询配置
      properties:
        page_number:
          type: integer
          description: 页码
          minimum: 1
          example: 1
        page_size:
          type: integer
          description: 每页大小
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 100
          example: 20

    RepairConfig:
      type: object
      description: 修复配置
      properties:
        diagnosis_level:
          type: string
          description: 诊断级别
          enum:
            - quick
            - standard
            - comprehensive
          example: standard
        repair_type:
          type: string
          description: 修复类型
          enum:
            - system
            - network
            - database
            - application
            - performance
          example: system

    TrainingConfig:
      type: object
      description: 训练配置
      properties:
        model_type:
          type: string
          description: 模型类型
          enum:
            - classification
            - regression
            - clustering
            - nlp
          example: classification
        training_data:
          type: string
          description: 训练数据
          example: "训练数据集URL或内容"

    ValidationConfig:
      type: object
      description: 验证配置
      properties:
        parameters_to_validate:
          type: object
          description: 要验证的参数
        strict_mode:
          type: boolean
          description: 严格模式
          example: true
        auto_validate:
          type: boolean
          description: 自动验证
          example: true
        validation_strictness:
          type: string
          description: 验证严格程度
          enum:
            - relaxed
            - standard
            - strict
          example: standard

  securitySchemes:
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: JWT Bearer Token认证
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
      description: API密钥认证
    CozeAPIKey:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Coze-API-Key
      description: Coze平台API密钥（从Coze控制台→API密钥管理获取）
    NoAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: 无认证模式（用于测试）

security:
  - BearerAuth: []
  - ApiKeyAuth: []
  - CozeAPIKey: []
