openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: CompleteAIWorkflowAutomationPlatform API
  description: |
    Complete AI workflow automation platform with integrated emergency activation, data enhancement, industry analysis, self-healing backup recovery, custom node development, workflow lifecycle management, intelligent generation, data connectivity, process orchestration, cultural heritage processing, model training, plugin automation and parameter validation.
    
    完整AI工作流自动化平台，集成了紧急激活、数据增强、行业分析、自愈备份恢复、自定义节点开发、工作流生命周期管理、智能生成、数据连接、流程编排、文化遗产处理、模型训练、插件自动化和参数验证。
    
    功能包括：
    - 激活紧急处理模式
    - 使用AI能力对输入数据进行增强处理
    - 专门处理行业分类和分析请求
    - 执行系统自动修复和诊断
    - 根据备份ID恢复系统状态
    - 创建自定义代码节点、插件节点或元数据节点，支持Python/JavaScript/TypeScript
    - 创建新的工作流定义
    - 根据ID删除特定工作流
    - 立即执行指定的工作流
    - 触发已生成的工作流执行，支持实时监控和结果返回
    - 向模型投喂训练数据
    - 根据用户需求描述自动生成完整工作流配置，支持电商、行业、编程等多种场景
    - 自动处理参数验证，确保符合规范
    - 生成基于行业的工作流程
    - 获取所有配置的数据连接列表
    - 根据ID获取特定工作流的详细信息
    - 获取用户有权访问的所有工作流列表，支持分页和过滤
    - 根据操作模式处理行业分析、工作流生成、自动修复、洛阳非遗模式等请求
    - 处理洛阳非物质文化遗产相关请求
    - 自动化检测并修复工作流内所有节点（配置/逻辑/依赖），无需人工干预
    - 启动自动化AI模型训练流程
    - 输入描述生成插件，并自动创建工作流执行链，支持任意节点触发和全节点自愈
    - 更新现有工作流的定义
    - 专门用于参数验证的工具端点，防止Invalid params错误
  version: 1.0.0
  contact:
    name: AI Workflow Platform Team
    email: support@aiworkflowplatform.com
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

servers:
  - url: https://api.aiworkflowplatform.com/v1
    description: Production API server
  - url: https://staging-api.aiworkflowplatform.com/v1
    description: Staging API server
  - url: https://dev-api.aiworkflowplatform.com/v1
    description: Development API server

paths:
  /operations/execute:
    post:
      operationId: executeUnifiedOperation
      summary: Execute unified platform operation
      description: |
        Execute operations across all platform capabilities including emergency activation, AI enhancement, industry analysis, auto-repair, backup recovery, custom node creation, workflow management, data feeding, automated generation, data connection management, process automation, cultural heritage processing, model training, plugin automation and parameter validation.
        
        执行跨所有平台能力的操作，包括紧急激活、AI增强、行业分析、自动修复、备份恢复、自定义节点创建、工作流管理、数据投喂、自动生成、数据连接管理、流程自动化、文化遗产处理、模型训练、插件自动化和参数验证。
      tags:
        - UnifiedOperations
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedOperationRequest'
            examples:
              emergency_activation:
                summary: Emergency activation example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "emergency_activation"
                  input_data:
                    emergency_type: "system_failure"
                    severity: "critical"
                    recovery_priority: "high"
                    affected_components: ["database", "api_gateway"]
                    automatic_recovery: true
              ai_enhancement:
                summary: AI enhancement example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "ai_enhancement"
                  input_data:
                    data_type: "text"
                    enhancement_type: "semantic_enrichment"
                    input_text: "Sample text for enhancement"
                    quality_threshold: 0.9
              industry_analysis:
                summary: Industry analysis example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "industry_analysis"
                  input_data:
                    industry: "technology"
                    analysis_type: "market_trends"
                    time_period: "2024"
                    geographic_scope: "global"
                    analysis_depth: "comprehensive"
                  industry_type: "technology"
              auto_repair:
                summary: Auto repair example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "auto_repair"
                  input_data:
                    repair_scope: "system_wide"
                    target_components: ["workflow_engine", "data_pipeline"]
                    repair_strategy: "automatic"
                    diagnostic_level: "comprehensive"
                  repair_level: "high"
              backup_recovery:
                summary: Backup recovery example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "backup_recovery"
                  input_data:
                    recovery_type: "full"
                    target_environment: "production"
                    verification_required: true
                  backup_id: "backup_20251106_120000"
              custom_node_creation:
                summary: Custom node creation example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "custom_node_creation"
                  input_data:
                    node_language: "Python"
                    node_type: "processor"
                    functionality: "data_transformation"
                  node_config:
                    name: "custom_data_processor"
                    language: "Python"
                    code: "def process_data(input): return input.upper()"
                    dependencies: ["pandas", "numpy"]
              workflow_management:
                summary: Workflow management example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "workflow_management"
                  input_data:
                    management_action: "create"
                    workflow_definition:
                      name: "data_processing_workflow"
                      nodes: ["input_node", "process_node", "output_node"]
                      connections: ["input_to_process", "process_to_output"]
                  workflow_id: "wf_new_123456"
              cultural_heritage_processing:
                summary: Cultural heritage processing example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "cultural_heritage_processing"
                  input_data:
                    heritage_data:
                      category: "traditional_craft"
                      origin: "Luoyang"
                      historical_period: "Tang Dynasty"
                    processing_type: "digital_archiving"
                    preservation_level: "high"
                  heritage_category: "luoyang_intangible_culture"
              model_training:
                summary: Model training example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "model_training"
                  input_data:
                    model_type: "classification"
                    training_algorithm: "neural_network"
                    epochs: 100
                    batch_size: 32
                  training_data:
                    - {features: [1,2,3], label: "A"}
                    - {features: [4,5,6], label: "B"}
              plugin_automation:
                summary: Plugin automation example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "plugin_automation"
                  input_data:
                    plugin_type: "data_processor"
                    target_platform: "coze"
                    automation_level: "full"
                  plugin_description: "Create a data processing plugin for Coze platform"
              parameter_validation:
                summary: Parameter validation example
                value:
                  operation_mode: "parameter_validation"
                  input_data:
                    parameters_to_validate:
                      param1: "value1"
                      param2: 123
                      param3: true
                  validation_rules:
                    param1:
                      type: "string"
                      required: true
                    param2:
                      type: "number"
                      min: 0
                      max: 1000
                    param3:
                      type: "boolean"
                  validation_level: "strict"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Operation executed successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedOperationResponse'
              examples:
                success:
                  summary: Success response
                  value:
                    status: "success"
                    result:
                      processed_data: "Enhanced text content"
                      items_processed: 150
                      success_rate: 0.95
                    workflow_id: "wf_123456"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-06T12:00:00Z"
                    execution_time: 150
                error:
                  summary: Error response
                  value:
                    status: "error"
                    result:
                      error_code: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
                      error_message: "Parameter validation failed"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-06T12:00:00Z"
        '400':
          description: Invalid request parameters
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /health:
    get:
      operationId: healthCheck
      summary: Health check endpoint
      description: Check API service health status
      tags:
        - SystemManagement
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: "healthy"
                  timestamp:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  version:
                    type: string
                    example: "1.0.0"

  /supported-operations:
    get:
      operationId: getSupportedOperations
      summary: Get supported operations list
      description: Retrieve all supported operation modes and their requirements
      tags:
        - SystemManagement
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of supported operations
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  supported_operations:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        operation_mode:
                          type: string
                        description:
                          type: string
                        required_parameters:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                  timestamp:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time

  /workflows/{workflow_id}:
    get:
      operationId: getWorkflowDetails
      summary: Get specific workflow details by ID
      description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific workflow
      tags:
        - WorkflowManagement
      parameters:
        - name: workflow_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Workflow identifier
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Workflow details retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  workflow_id:
                    type: string
                  name:
                    type: string
                  status:
                    type: string
                  nodes:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                  connections:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                  created_at:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  updated_at:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
        '404':
          description: Workflow not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /workflows:
    get:
      operationId: listWorkflows
      summary: List all accessible workflows
      description: Get list of all workflows accessible to the user with pagination and filtering
      tags:
        - WorkflowManagement
      parameters:
        - name: page
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            default: 1
          description: Page number for pagination
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
          description: Number of items per page
        - name: status
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by workflow status
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Workflows list retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  workflows:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        workflow_id:
                          type: string
                        name:
                          type: string
                        status:
                          type: string
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time
                  pagination:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      total:
                        type: integer
                      page:
                        type: integer
                      limit:
                        type: integer
                      total_pages:
                        type: integer

  /data-connections:
    get:
      operationId: listDataConnections
      summary: List all configured data connections
      description: Get list of all configured data connections
      tags:
        - DataManagement
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Data connections list retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  connections:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        connection_id:
                          type: string
                        name:
                          type: string
                        type:
                          type: string
                        status:
                          type: string
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time

components:
  schemas:
    UnifiedOperationRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - operation_mode
        - input_data
      properties:
        operation_mode:
          type: string
          enum:
            - emergency_activation
            - ai_enhancement
            - industry_analysis
            - auto_repair
            - backup_recovery
            - custom_node_creation
            - workflow_management
            - data_feeding
            - automated_generation
            - data_connection_management
            - process_automation
            - cultural_heritage_processing
            - model_training
            - plugin_automation
            - parameter_validation
          description: Operation mode selection
        input_data:
          type: object
          description: Input data for processing
        workflow_id:
          type: string
          description: Workflow identifier for specific operations
        backup_id:
          type: string
          description: Backup identifier for recovery operations
        node_config:
          type: object
          description: Configuration for custom node creation
        training_data:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
          description: Training dataset for model training
        plugin_description:
          type: string
          description: Description for plugin generation
        validation_rules:
          type: object
          description: Rules for parameter validation
        industry_type:
          type: string
          description: Industry type for analysis
        heritage_category:
          type: string
          description: Cultural heritage category
        repair_level:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high, critical]
          description: Level of auto-repair to perform
        generation_template:
          type: string
          description: Template for automated generation
        emergency_type:
          type: string
          enum: [system_failure, security_breach, performance_degradation, data_corruption]
          description: Type of emergency for activation
        severity:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high, critical]
          description: Severity level for emergency operations
        data_type:
          type: string
          enum: [text, image, audio, video, tabular, time_series]
          description: Type of data for enhancement
        enhancement_type:
          type: string
          enum: [semantic_enrichment, quality_improvement, feature_extraction, pattern_recognition, anomaly_detection]
          description: Type of enhancement to apply
        analysis_type:
          type: string
          enum: [market_trends, competitive_analysis, risk_assessment, opportunity_identification, regulatory_compliance]
          description: Type of analysis to perform
        recovery_type:
          type: string
          enum: [full, partial, point_in_time, incremental]
          description: Type of recovery to perform
        node_language:
          type: string
          enum: [Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go]
          description: Programming language for custom node
        management_action:
          type: string
          enum: [create, read, update, delete, execute, monitor]
          description: Action for workflow management
        processing_type:
          type: string
          enum: [digital_archiving, cultural_analysis, preservation_planning, historical_research]
          description: Type of cultural heritage processing
        model_type:
          type: string
          description: Type of AI model for training
        plugin_type:
          type: string
          description: Type of plugin to generate
        validation_level:
          type: string
          enum: [basic, standard, strict]
          description: Level of parameter validation
        recovery_priority:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high, critical]
          description: Recovery priority level
        affected_components:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: List of affected system components
        automatic_recovery:
          type: boolean
          description: Enable automatic recovery
        enhancement_parameters:
          type: object
          description: Enhancement-specific parameters
        quality_threshold:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1
          description: Quality threshold for enhancement
        time_period:
          type: string
          description: Analysis time period
        geographic_scope:
          type: string
          description: Geographic scope of analysis
        analysis_depth:
          type: string
          enum: [overview, detailed, comprehensive]
          description: Depth of analysis
        repair_scope:
          type: string
          enum: [system_wide, component_specific, workflow_specific, data_specific]
          description: Scope of repair operation
        target_components:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Specific components to repair
        repair_strategy:
          type: string
          enum: [automatic, guided, manual]
          description: Repair strategy
        diagnostic_level:
          type: string
          enum: [basic, standard, comprehensive]
          description: Diagnostic depth level
        target_environment:
          type: string
          description: Target environment for recovery
        verification_required:
          type: boolean
          description: Perform recovery verification
        notification_settings:
          type: object
          description: Recovery notification settings
        page:
          type: integer
          description: Page number for pagination
        limit:
          type: integer
          description: Number of items per page
        filter_status:
          type: string
          description: Filter status for workflow listing
      example:
        operation_mode: "emergency_activation"
        input_data:
          emergency_type: "system_failure"
          severity: "critical"
          recovery_priority: "high"
          affected_components: ["database", "api_gateway"]
          automatic_recovery: true
        repair_level: "high"

    UnifiedOperationResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [success, error, pending]
          description: Operation status
        result:
          type: object
          description: Operation result data
        workflow_id:
          type: string
          description: Generated workflow identifier
        backup_id:
          type: string
          description: Created backup identifier
        node_id:
          type: string
          description: Created node identifier
        training_id:
          type: string
          description: Training process identifier
        plugin_id:
          type: string
          description: Generated plugin identifier
        validation_result:
          type: object
          description: Parameter validation results
        analysis_report:
          type: object
          description: Industry analysis report
        enhancement_result:
          type: object
          description: AI enhancement results
        repair_report:
          type: object
          description: Auto-repair diagnostic report
        generation_output:
          type: object
          description: Automated generation output
        emergency_id:
          type: string
          description: Emergency activation identifier
        recovery_id:
          type: string
          description: Recovery operation identifier
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Operation completion timestamp
        execution_time:
          type: number
          description: Operation execution time in milliseconds
        error_details:
          type: object
          description: Error details if operation failed
        connection_list:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
          description: List of data connections
        workflow_list:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
          description: List of workflows
        model_performance:
          type: object
          description: Model training performance metrics
        plugin_configuration:
          type: object
          description: Generated plugin configuration
        enhanced_data:
          type: object
          description: Enhanced output data
        enhancement_metrics:
          type: object
          description: Enhancement performance metrics
        quality_score:
          type: number
          description: Quality assessment score
        processing_time:
          type: number
          description: Processing time in milliseconds
        executive_summary:
          type: string
          description: Executive summary of findings
        key_insights:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Key insights from analysis
        market_trends:
          type: object
          description: Market trend analysis
        competitive_landscape:
          type: object
          description: Competitive landscape analysis
        risk_assessment:
          type: object
          description: Risk assessment results
        recommendations:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Strategic recommendations
        issues_detected:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
          description: Detected issues
        repairs_performed:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Repairs performed
        system_health_score:
          type: number
          description: Post-repair system health score
        recovered_components:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: Successfully recovered components
        recovery_duration:
          type: number
          description: Recovery duration in seconds
        verification_results:
          type: object
          description: Recovery verification results
      example:
        status: "success"
        result:
          processed_items: 150
          success_rate: 0.95
          enhanced_data: "Processed and enhanced content"
        workflow_id: "wf_123456"
        backup_id: "backup_20251106_120000"
        node_id: "node_custom_processor_001"
        timestamp: "2025-11-06T12:00:00Z"
        execution_time: 250

    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        error_code:
          type: string
          description: Error code identifier
        error_message:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable error message
        error_details:
          type: object
          description: Additional error details
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Error occurrence timestamp
        request_id:
          type: string
          description: Request identifier for debugging
      example:
        error_code: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        error_message: "Required parameter 'input_data' is missing"
        error_details:
          missing_parameters: ["input_data"]
          invalid_parameters: []
        timestamp: "2025-11-06T12:00:00Z"
        request_id: "req_123456"

  securitySchemes:
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key

security:
  - BearerAuth: []
  - ApiKeyAuth: []

  - name: UnifiedOperations
    description: Unified platform operations across all capabilities
  - name: SystemManagement
    description: System management and health check endpoints
  - name: WorkflowManagement
    description: Workflow lifecycle management operations
  - name: DataManagement
    description: Data connection and management operations

openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: 企业工作流智能编排系统 API
  description: "统一的企业级工作流管理、自动化执行和智能编排平台，集成30个核心功能模块"
  version: "1.0.0"
  contact:
    name: "技术支持团队"
    email: "support@enterprise-workflow.com"
    url: "https://enterprise-workflow.com"
  license:
    name: "商业许可"
    url: "https://enterprise-workflow.com/license"

servers:
  - url: "https://api.enterprise-workflow.com/v1"
    description: "生产环境"
  - url: "https://staging-api.enterprise-workflow.com/v1"
    description: "测试环境"
  - url: "https://dev-api.enterprise-workflow.com/v1"
    description: "开发环境"

paths:
  /execute:
    post:
      operationId: "universalExecute"
      summary: "统一执行端点"
      description: "通过统一的API端点执行所有30种功能操作"
      tags:
        - "Universal Operations"
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UniversalRequest"
            examples:
              emergency_example:
                summary: "紧急模式激活示例"
                value:
                  operation_type: "activate_emergency"
                  operation_config:
                    emergency_config:
                      emergency_level: "critical"
                      activation_reason: "系统检测到严重安全威胁"
                      auto_recovery: true
                      recovery_strategy: "immediate"
                      notification_contacts: ["admin@company.com", "ops@company.com"]
                  version: "v2.0"
                  async_execution: false
                  validation_config:
                    auto_validate: true
                    validation_strictness: "strict"
              workflow_example:
                summary: "工作流生成示例"
                value:
                  operation_type: "generate_workflow"
                  operation_config:
                    workflow_config:
                      requirement_description: "需要创建一个电商订单处理工作流，包含库存检查、支付验证和物流分配"
                      business_domain: "ecommerce"
                      complexity_level: "medium"
                      validation_strictness: "standard"
                  version: "v1.0"
                  async_execution: true
                  callback_url: "https://webhook.company.com/callback"
              ai_enhancement_example:
                summary: "AI数据增强示例"
                value:
                  operation_type: "ai_enhancement"
                  operation_config:
                    ai_enhancement_config:
                      input_data: "需要清洗和增强的用户行为数据..."
                      enhancement_type: "cleaning"
                      output_format: "json"
                  version: "v1.0"
                  async_execution: false
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "操作执行成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/UniversalResponse"
              examples:
                success_sync:
                  summary: "同步执行成功"
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_123456789"
                    result:
                      workflow_definition:
                        nodes:
                          - id: "node_1"
                            type: "input"
                            name: "订单接收"
                          - id: "node_2"
                            type: "process"
                            name: "库存检查"
                        connections:
                          - from: "node_1"
                            to: "node_2"
                      validation_results:
                        valid: true
                        warnings: []
                    execution_time: 2.45
                    timestamp: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
                success_async:
                  summary: "异步执行已接受"
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_987654321"
                    status: "accepted"
                    monitor_url: "https://api.enterprise-workflow.com/v1/operations/op_987654321"
                    estimated_completion: "2024-01-15T10:35:00Z"
                    timestamp: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
        "202":
          description: "异步操作已接受"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AsyncResponse"
        "400":
          description: "请求参数错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                invalid_enum:
                  summary: "枚举值无效"
                  value:
                    error_code: "INVALID_PARAM_ENUM"
                    error_message: "参数值不在允许的枚举范围内"
                    error_details:
                      field: "operation_config.emergency_config.emergency_level"
                      provided_value: "urgent"
                      allowed_values: ["low", "medium", "high", "critical", "level1", "level2", "level3", "level4"]
                    suggestion: "请使用允许的枚举值：low, medium, high, critical, level1, level2, level3, level4"
                    timestamp: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
                missing_required:
                  summary: "缺少必需参数"
                  value:
                    error_code: "MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAM"
                    error_message: "缺少必需的参数"
                    error_details:
                      missing_fields: ["workflow_id", "confirmation"]
                    suggestion: "请提供所有必需的参数"
                    timestamp: "2024-01-15T10:31:00Z"
        "401":
          description: "未授权访问"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              example:
                error_code: "UNAUTHORIZED"
                error_message: "访问令牌无效或已过期"
                suggestion: "请检查Bearer Token是否正确"
                timestamp: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
        "500":
          description: "服务器内部错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              example:
                error_code: "INTERNAL_ERROR"
                error_message: "服务器处理请求时发生内部错误"
                suggestion: "请稍后重试或联系技术支持"
                timestamp: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"

  /operations/{operation_id}:
    get:
      operationId: "getOperationStatus"
      summary: "获取操作状态"
      description: "查询异步操作的执行状态和结果"
      tags:
        - "Operation Monitoring"
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: "operation_id"
          in: "path"
          required: true
          schema:
            type: "string"
          description: "操作ID"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "操作状态信息"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/OperationStatus"
              example:
                operation_id: "op_123456789"
                status: "processing"
                progress: 65
                created_at: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
                updated_at: "2024-01-15T10:31:00Z"
                estimated_remaining: 120
        "404":
          description: "操作未找到"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          description: "服务器内部错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"

  /validate:
    post:
      operationId: "validateOperationParameters"
      summary: "预验证操作参数"
      description: "在执行操作前验证参数的合法性"
      tags:
        - "Validation"
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UniversalRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "验证结果"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: "object"
                properties:
                  is_valid:
                    type: "boolean"
                  validation_errors:
                    type: "array"
                    items:
                      type: "object"
                      properties:
                        field:
                          type: "string"
                        error:
                          type: "string"
                        suggestion:
                          type: "string"
                  suggestions:
                    type: "array"
                    items:
                      type: "string"
              example:
                is_valid: false
                validation_errors:
                  - field: "operation_config.emergency_config.emergency_level"
                    error: "值 'urgent' 不在允许的枚举值中"
                    suggestion: "请使用: low, medium, high, critical"
                suggestions:
                  - "emergency_level 应该为 low, medium, high, critical 之一"

  /health:
    get:
      operationId: "healthCheck"
      summary: "健康检查"
      description: "检查服务健康状态和各模块可用性"
      tags:
        - "System"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "服务健康"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: "object"
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: "string"
                    enum: ["healthy", "degraded", "unhealthy"]
                  timestamp:
                    type: "string"
                    format: "date-time"
                  components:
                    type: "object"
                    properties:
                      workflow_engine:
                        type: "string"
                        enum: ["up", "down", "degraded"]
                      ai_services:
                        type: "string"
                        enum: ["up", "down", "degraded"]
                      system_ops:
                        type: "string"
                        enum: ["up", "down", "degraded"]
                      cultural_services:
                        type: "string"
                        enum: ["up", "down", "degraded"]
                      database:
                        type: "string"
                        enum: ["connected", "disconnected"]
                      cache:
                        type: "string"
                        enum: ["connected", "disconnected"]
                  version:
                    type: "string"
                  uptime:
                    type: "number"
              example:
                status: "healthy"
                timestamp: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
                components:
                  workflow_engine: "up"
                  ai_services: "up"
                  system_ops: "up"
                  cultural_services: "up"
                  database: "connected"
                  cache: "connected"
                version: "1.0.0"
                uptime: 86400

components:
  schemas:
    UniversalRequest:
      type: "object"
      required:
        - "operation_type"
        - "operation_config"
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "activate_emergency"
            - "ai_enhancement"
            - "analyze_industry"
            - "auto_repair"
            - "backup_revert"
            - "create_custom_node"
            - "create_workflow"
            - "delete_workflow"
            - "execute_workflow"
            - "feed_data"
            - "generate_workflow"
            - "get_data_connections"
            - "get_workflow_by_id"
            - "get_workflows"
            - "process_automation"
            - "process_luoyang_heritage"
            - "repair_all_nodes"
            - "train_model"
            - "trigger_auto_plugin_workflow"
            - "update_workflow"
            - "validate_parameters"
          description: "要执行的操作类型"
        operation_config:
          type: "object"
          description: "操作配置参数"
          properties:
            emergency_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EmergencyConfig"
            ai_enhancement_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AIEnhancementConfig"
            workflow_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig"
            repair_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RepairConfig"
            backup_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/BackupConfig"
            custom_node_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CustomNodeConfig"
            industry_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/IndustryConfig"
            training_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/TrainingConfig"
            heritage_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/HeritageConfig"
            automation_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AutomationConfig"
            validation_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/ValidationConfig"
            plugin_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/PluginConfig"
            connection_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/ConnectionConfig"
            query_config:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/QueryConfig"
        version:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["v1.0", "v2.0", "v3.0"]
          default: "v1.0"
          description: "功能版本号"
        async_execution:
          type: "boolean"
          default: false
          description: "是否异步执行"
        callback_url:
          type: "string"
          format: "uri"
          description: "异步回调URL"
        validation_config:
          type: "object"
          description: "验证配置"
          properties:
            auto_validate:
              type: "boolean"
              description: "是否自动验证参数"
            validation_strictness:
              type: "string"
              enum: ["relaxed", "standard", "strict"]
              description: "验证严格程度"
            error_handling:
              type: "string"
              enum: ["strict", "lenient", "adaptive"]
              description: "错误处理策略"

    UniversalResponse:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        success:
          type: "boolean"
          description: "操作是否成功"
        operation_id:
          type: "string"
          description: "操作唯一标识符"
        status:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["completed", "processing", "failed", "accepted"]
          description: "操作状态"
        result:
          type: "object"
          description: "操作结果数据"
        error:
          type: "object"
          description: "错误信息"
          properties:
            code:
              type: "string"
            message:
              type: "string"
            details:
              type: "object"
        execution_time:
          type: "number"
          description: "执行时间（秒）"
        timestamp:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
          description: "响应时间戳"
        monitor_url:
          type: "string"
          format: "uri"
          description: "监控URL（异步操作）"

    AsyncResponse:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        success:
          type: "boolean"
          description: "操作是否成功"
        operation_id:
          type: "string"
          description: "操作唯一标识符"
        status:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["accepted"]
          description: "操作状态"
        monitor_url:
          type: "string"
          format: "uri"
          description: "监控URL"
        estimated_completion:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
          description: "预计完成时间"

    OperationStatus:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        operation_id:
          type: "string"
        status:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["pending", "processing", "completed", "failed", "cancelled"]
        progress:
          type: "number"
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
          description: "执行进度百分比"
        result:
          type: "object"
          description: "操作结果（完成后可用）"
        error:
          type: "object"
          description: "错误信息（失败时可用）"
        created_at:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
        updated_at:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
        estimated_remaining:
          type: "number"
          description: "预计剩余时间（秒）"

    ErrorResponse:
      type: "object"
      required:
        - "error_code"
        - "message"
      properties:
        error_code:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "INVALID_PARAMS"
            - "UNAUTHORIZED"
            - "OPERATION_NOT_FOUND"
            - "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE"
            - "RATE_LIMITED"
            - "INTERNAL_ERROR"
        message:
          type: "string"
        details:
          type: "object"
        timestamp:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
        request_id:
          type: "string"

    EmergencyConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        emergency_level:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["low", "medium", "high", "critical", "level1", "level2", "level3", "level4"]
        activation_reason:
          type: "string"
        auto_recovery:
          type: "boolean"
        recovery_strategy:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["immediate", "gradual", "manual"]
        notification_contacts:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"
            format: "email"

    AIEnhancementConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        input_data:
          type: "string"
        enhancement_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["cleaning", "enrichment", "completion", "quality_improvement"]
        output_format:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["json", "xml", "csv", "text"]
        batch_data:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "object"
        options:
          type: "object"

    WorkflowConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        workflow_id:
          type: "string"
        workflow_name:
          type: "string"
        description:
          type: "string"
        nodes:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "object"
        triggers:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "object"
        requirement_description:
          type: "string"
        business_domain:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["ecommerce", "industry", "programming", "finance", "healthcare", "manufacturing", "retail", "education"]
        execution_parameters:
          type: "object"
        update_operations:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "object"
        complexity_level:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["simple", "medium", "complex"]
        validation_strictness:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["relaxed", "standard", "strict"]
        monitoring_level:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["basic", "detailed", "verbose"]
        result_format:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["summary", "detailed", "raw"]
        version_comment:
          type: "string"
        tags:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"

    RepairConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        repair_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["system", "network", "database", "application", "performance"]
        diagnosis_level:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["quick", "standard", "comprehensive", "deep", "predictive"]
        diagnosis_mode:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["quick", "deep", "predictive"]
        auto_execute:
          type: "boolean"
        repair_strategy:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["auto", "semi_auto", "manual_approval"]
        backup_before_repair:
          type: "boolean"
        repair_scope:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["configuration", "logic", "dependencies", "all"]
        target_components:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"

    BackupConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        backup_id:
          type: "string"
        revert_scope:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["full", "partial", "data_only"]
        revert_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["full", "incremental", "selective"]
        confirmation_required:
          type: "boolean"
        target_components:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"
        preview_changes:
          type: "boolean"
        rollback_plan:
          type: "string"
        conflict_resolution:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["overwrite", "merge", "skip"]

    CustomNodeConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        node_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["code", "plugin", "metadata"]
        programming_language:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["python", "javascript", "typescript"]
        node_name:
          type: "string"
        code_content:
          type: "string"
        dependencies:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"
        configuration:
          type: "object"
        description:
          type: "string"

    IndustryConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        industry_name:
          type: "string"
        analysis_depth:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["basic", "standard", "comprehensive"]
        analysis_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["classification", "trends", "competitive", "risk"]
        industry_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["manufacturing", "retail", "healthcare", "finance", "education"]
        time_period:
          type: "string"
        include_trends:
          type: "boolean"
        include_forecast:
          type: "boolean"
        region:
          type: "string"
        data_sources:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"
        geographic_scope:
          type: "string"
        forecast_period:
          type: "string"
        comparison_metrics:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"

    TrainingConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        training_data:
          type: "string"
        training_dataset:
          type: "string"
        model_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["classification", "regression", "clustering", "nlp"]
        model_target:
          type: "string"
        data_format:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["json", "csv", "text", "image"]
        validation_split:
          type: "number"
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1
        training_parameters:
          type: "object"
        preprocessing:
          type: "object"
        data_quality_check:
          type: "boolean"
        hyperparameter_tuning:
          type: "boolean"

    HeritageConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        heritage_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["intangible", "tangible", "cultural_practice"]
        heritage_category:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["traditional_craft", "performing_arts", "rituals", "oral_traditions"]
        action_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["query", "register", "update", "preserve"]
        processing_mode:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["cataloging", "digital_preservation", "public_display", "research"]
        heritage_data:
          type: "object"
        cultural_context:
          type: "object"
        preservation_level:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["basic", "standard", "premium"]
        location:
          type: "string"
        digital_assets:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"

    AutomationConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        operation_mode:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["industry_analysis", "workflow_generation", "auto_repair", "luoyang_heritage", "custom"]
        input_data:
          type: "object"
        input_parameters:
          type: "object"
        processing_level:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["basic", "advanced", "comprehensive"]
        optimization_level:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["standard", "optimized", "max_performance"]
        error_handling:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["strict", "lenient", "adaptive"]
        output_format:
          type: "string"
        parallel_processing:
          type: "boolean"

    ValidationConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        parameters_to_validate:
          type: "object"
        validation_rules:
          type: "object"
        strict_mode:
          type: "boolean"
        context:
          type: "object"

    PluginConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        plugin_description:
          type: "string"
        trigger_conditions:
          type: "object"
        self_healing_enabled:
          type: "boolean"
        execution_priority:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["low", "normal", "high", "critical"]
        node_types:
          type: "array"
          items:
            type: "string"

    ConnectionConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        connection_type:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["all", "database", "api", "file", "streaming"]
        status_filter:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["all", "active", "inactive", "error"]
        include_details:
          type: "boolean"

    QueryConfig:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        page_number:
          type: "integer"
          minimum: 1
        page_size:
          type: "integer"
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 100
        filter_by_status:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["all", "active", "inactive", "draft"]
        sort_by:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["name", "created_date", "modified_date"]
        include_execution_history:
          type: "boolean"
        include_node_details:
          type: "boolean"

  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: "http"
      scheme: "bearer"
      bearerFormat: "JWT"
      description: "使用JWT Bearer Token进行认证"

security:
  - bearerAuth: []

tags:
  - name: "Universal Operations"
    description: "统一功能操作端点"
  - name: "Operation Monitoring"
    description: "操作状态监控和管理"
  - name: "Validation"
    description: "参数验证服务"
  - name: "System"
    description: "系统管理和健康检查"

# ===================================================================
# 统一智能自动化工具套件 - 完整YAML配置
# 版本: 3.0.0-Complete-Unified
# 说明: 整合所有功能模块的单一配置文件

openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: "统一智能自动化超级中枢"
  version: "3.0.0-Complete-Unified"
  description: |
    🎯 完全统一的单一智能自动化工具 - 深度整合所有功能模块
    ✅ 单一端点处理所有核心功能 | ✅ 智能路由决策 | ✅ 全链路监控
    ✅ 企业级稳定性 | ✅ 支持自然语言和参数化两种模式

    📋 整合功能列表：

    - Coze JSON修复器 & 插件修复

    - 工作流修复工具 & 优化
    - 多模态数据处理 & 融合

    - 代码生成 & 自动修复
    - API规范验证 & 兼容性检查

    - 系统监控 & 自愈
    - 性能优化 & 分析
    - 模板管理 & 自定义
    - 会话管理 & 持久化

  contact:

  license:
    name: "Apache 2.0"
    url: "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html"

  - url: "https://staging.unified-automation.com/v1"
    description: "测试环境API服务器"

tags:
  - name: "统一智能自动化"
    description: "单一工具处理所有自动化功能"
  - name: "系统监控"
    description: "操作状态监控、健康检查和管理"
  - name: "参数验证"
    description: "参数验证和智能修复"
  - name: "批量处理"
    description: "批量文件处理"
  - name: "代码生成"
    description: "智能代码生成"
  - name: "数据处理"
    description: "多模态数据处理"

paths:

      operationId: executeUnifiedAutomation

      description: |
        全能统一自动化工具 | 支持用户选择是否启用自动化处理
        
        💡 核心功能整合：
        - 神经决策系统 & 智能路由
        - Coze JSON修复 & 插件修复
        - MCP服务器创建
        - 工作流自动化生成
        - 代码生成与修复
        - 多模态数据处理
        - AI增强优化
        - 错误检测修复
        - 参数验证修复
        - 系统监控自愈
        
        🎮 使用模式：
        - 简单模式：自然语言描述，系统自动分析执行
        - 专业模式：结构化参数精确控制
        - 自动模式：全自动化处理，无需人工干预
        - 手动模式：关键步骤人工确认
        
        ⚙️ 自动化控制：用户可随时启用/禁用自动化处理
      tags:
        - "统一智能自动化"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SimpleRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProfessionalRequest'
            examples:
              简单模式示例:
                summary: "简单自然语言模式"
                value:
                  user_request: "帮我创建一个Coze插件，包含用户认证和数据处理功能"
                  enable_automation: true
                  automation_level: "comprehensive"
                  function_selection:
                    code_generation: true
                    workflow_automation: true
                    error_fixing: true
                    data_processing: true
              专业模式示例:
                summary: "专业参数模式"
                value:
                  operation_type: "coze_plugin_repair"
                  operation_config:
                    plugin_config:
                      plugin_name: "修复后的插件"
                      version: "1.0.0"
                    repair_config:
                      repair_depth: "comprehensive"
                      auto_fix: true
                  enable_automation: true
                  automation_level: "full"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "同步操作成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedSuccessResponse'
        '202':
          description: "异步操作已接受"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncOperationResponse'
        '400':
          description: "参数验证失败"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /automation-control:
    post:
      summary: "自动化控制管理"
      description: "动态调整自动化处理级别和模式"
      tags:
        - "统一智能自动化"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                automation_enabled:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否启用自动化处理"
                  default: true
                automation_level:
                  type: string
                  enum: ["none", "basic", "standard", "comprehensive", "full"]
                  description: "自动化处理级别"
                  default: "standard"
                confirmation_required:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "关键步骤是否需要确认"
                  default: false
                auto_retry_enabled:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否启用自动重试"
                  default: true
                optimization_enabled:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否启用优化"
                  default: true
              required:
                - "automation_enabled"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "控制设置成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  success:
                    type: boolean
                  current_settings:
                    type: object
                  message:
                    type: string

  /batch-process:
    post:
      summary: "批量处理"
      description: "批量处理目录中的所有文件"
      tags:
        - "批量处理"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                directory:
                  type: string
                  description: "要处理的目录路径"
                operation_mode:
                  type: string
                  description: "操作模式"
                  default: "auto_detect"
                automation_level:
                  type: string
                  description: "自动化级别"
                  default: "standard"
                max_workers:
                  type: integer
                  description: "最大并行数"
                  default: 4
                file_patterns:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
                  description: "文件匹配模式"
                recursive:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否递归处理子目录"
                  default: true
              required:
                - "directory"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "批量处理完成"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  success:
                    type: boolean
                  total_files:
                    type: integer
                  processed_files:
                    type: integer
                  successful:
                    type: integer
                  failed:
                    type: integer
                  processing_time:
                    type: number
                  export_file:
                    type: string

  /generate-code:
    post:
      summary: "代码生成"
      description: "根据需求生成代码"
      tags:
        - "代码生成"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                requirements:
                  type: string
                  description: "代码需求描述"
                language:
                  type: string
                  description: "编程语言"
                  enum: ["python", "javascript", "typescript", "java", "go", "rust"]
                  default: "python"
                template_type:
                  type: string
                  description: "模板类型"
                  default: "auto_detect"
                include_tests:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否包含测试代码"
                  default: true
                include_docs:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否包含文档"
                  default: true
              required:
                - "requirements"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "代码生成成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  success:
                    type: boolean
                  generated_code:
                    type: string
                  file_structure:
                    type: object
                  dependencies:
                    type: array
                  validation:
                    type: object

  /system-status:
    get:
      summary: "系统状态"
      description: "获取系统运行状态"
      tags:
        - "系统监控"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "系统状态信息"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                  uptime:
                    type: number
                  operations_count:
                    type: integer
                  success_rate:
                    type: number
                  resource_usage:
                    type: object

  /generate-report:
    get:
      summary: "生成报告"
      description: "生成系统运行报告"
      tags:
        - "系统监控"
      parameters:
        - name: report_type
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: ["hourly", "daily", "weekly", "monthly"]
            default: "daily"
          description: "报告类型"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "报告生成成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  report_type:
                    type: string
                  time_period:
                    type: string
                  summary:
                    type: object
                  recommendations:
                    type: array

components:
  schemas:
    SimpleRequest:
      type: object
      description: "简单用户请求模式"
      properties:
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: "用户自然语言需求描述"
          minLength: 10
          maxLength: 5000
          example: "创建一个完整的Coze插件，包含用户系统、数据处理和API集成"
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: "是否启用自动化处理"
          default: true
        automation_level:
          type: string
          enum: ["none", "basic", "standard", "comprehensive", "full"]
          description: "自动化处理级别"
          default: "standard"
        function_selection:
          type: object
          description: "功能选择配置"
          properties:
            code_generation:
              type: boolean
              description: "代码生成"
              default: true
            workflow_automation:
              type: boolean
              description: "工作流自动化"
              default: true
            data_processing:
              type: boolean
              description: "数据处理"
              default: true
            ai_enhancement:
              type: boolean
              description: "AI增强"
              default: true
            error_fixing:
              type: boolean
              description: "错误修复"
              default: true
            system_monitoring:
              type: boolean
              description: "系统监控"
              default: true
        output_format:
          type: string
          enum: ["json_pretty", "json_minified", "yaml", "coze_import", "python_code", "markdown"]
          description: "输出格式"
          default: "json_pretty"
      required:
        - "user_request"

    ProfessionalRequest:
      type: object
      description: "专业请求模式"
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: "操作类型"
          enum:
            - "coze_json_repair"
            - "mcp_server_creation"
            - "workflow_repair"
            - "plugin_creation"
            - "code_generation"
            - "data_processing"
            - "ai_training"
            - "api_specification"
            - "error_fixing"
            - "performance_optimization"
            - "system_monitoring"
          example: "coze_json_repair"
        operation_config:
          type: object
          description: "操作配置"
          properties:
            plugin_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PluginConfig'
            workflow_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig'
            code_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CodeConfig'
            data_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataConfig'
            repair_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RepairConfig'
        input_data:
          type: object
          description: "输入数据"
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: "是否启用自动化处理"
          default: true
        automation_level:
          type: string
          enum: ["none", "basic", "standard", "comprehensive", "full"]
          description: "自动化处理级别"
          default: "comprehensive"
        callback_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: "回调URL（异步操作）"
      required:
        - "operation_type"
        - "enable_automation"

    PluginConfig:
      type: object
      description: "插件配置"
      properties:
        plugin_name:
          type: string
          description: "插件名称"
          example: "数据处理器插件"
        version:
          type: string
          description: "版本号"
          default: "1.0.0"
        description:
          type: string
          description: "插件描述"
        author:
          type: string
          description: "作者"
        inputs:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              name:
                type: string
              type:
                type: string
              required:
                type: boolean
              description:
                type: string
        outputs:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              name:
                type: string
              type:
                type: string
              description:
                type: string

    WorkflowConfig:
      type: object
      description: "工作流配置"
      properties:
        workflow_type:
          type: string
          enum: ["business_process", "data_pipeline", "api_workflow", "system_automation"]
          example: "business_process"
        complexity_level:
          type: string
          enum: ["simple", "medium", "complex"]
          example: "medium"
        nodes_count:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 100
          example: 10
        include_error_handling:
          type: boolean
          default: true

    CodeConfig:
      type: object
      description: "代码配置"
      properties:
        programming_language:
          type: string
          enum: ["python", "javascript", "typescript", "java", "go", "rust"]
          example: "python"
        code_style:
          type: string
          enum: ["functional", "object_oriented", "procedural"]
          example: "object_oriented"
        include_comments:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        include_tests:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        include_docs:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        code_quality:
          type: string
          enum: ["basic", "standard", "enterprise"]
          example: "standard"

    DataConfig:
      type: object
      description: "数据配置"
      properties:
        data_source_type:
          type: string
          enum: ["database", "api", "file", "stream"]
          example: "database"
        processing_type:
          type: string
          enum: ["cleaning", "transformation", "analysis", "enrichment"]
          example: "transformation"
        output_format:
          type: string
          enum: ["json", "csv", "xml", "database"]
          example: "json"
        batch_size:
          type: integer
          default: 1000

    RepairConfig:
      type: object
      description: "修复配置"
      properties:
        repair_depth:
          type: string
          enum: ["basic", "comprehensive", "thorough"]
          default: "comprehensive"
        auto_fix:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        validate_after_fix:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        max_fix_attempts:
          type: integer
          default: 3
        backup_original:
          type: boolean
          default: true

    UnifiedSuccessResponse:
      type: object
      description: "统一成功响应"
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        automation_enabled:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        automation_level:
          type: string
          example: "comprehensive"
        processing_time:
          type: number
          example: 1.25
        results:
          type: object
          description: "操作结果"
          properties:
            generated_code:
              type: string
              description: "生成的代码"
            workflow_definition:
              type: object
              description: "工作流定义"
            data_processed:
              type: object
              description: "处理后的数据"
            documentation:
              type: string
              description: "生成的文档"
            configuration_files:
              type: object
              description: "配置文件"
            validation:
              type: object
              description: "验证结果"
        summary:
          type: object
          properties:
            processing_time:
              type: number
              description: "处理时间（秒）"
            files_generated:
              type: integer
              description: "生成的文件数量"
            quality_score:
              type: number
              description: "质量评分"
            automation_report:
              type: object
              description: "自动化处理报告"
      required:
        - "success"
        - "operation_id"

    AsyncOperationResponse:
      type: object
      description: "异步操作响应"
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        status:
          type: string
          enum: ["accepted", "processing", "completed", "failed"]
          example: "accepted"
        estimated_completion:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: "https://api.unified-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
      required:
        - "success"
        - "operation_id"
        - "status"

    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      description: "错误响应"
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
          example: 4001
        message:
          type: string
          example: "参数验证失败"
        details:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
              issue:
                type: string
              suggestion:
                type: string
        automation_fix_applied:
          type: boolean
          example: false
        fix_suggestions:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
      required:
        - "code"
        - "message"

    SystemStatus:
      type: object
      description: "系统状态"
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: ["healthy", "degraded", "unhealthy"]
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        uptime:
          type: number
        version:
          type: string
        operations:
          type: object
          properties:
            total:
              type: integer
            successful:
              type: integer
            failed:
              type: integer
            success_rate:
              type: number
        resource_usage:
          type: object
          properties:
            cpu_percent:
              type: number
            memory_percent:
              type: number
            disk_percent:
              type: number
        components:
          type: object
          properties:
            database:
              type: string
            automation_engine:
              type: string
            code_generator:
              type: string
            workflow_engine:
              type: string
        recommendations:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
