专题处理：洛阳唐三彩、龙门石窟等专项保护

8. 统一自动化网关
智能请求路由：自动识别请求类型并路由到相应模块

功能模块动态组合：支持多功能的链式调用

自适应处理策略：根据请求内容自动优化处理策略

负载均衡：分布式请求分发

熔断机制：故障隔离和自动恢复

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: 全能智能自动化超级中枢API
  description: 统一的多功能自动化处理工具，整合文本处理、数据分析、工作流管理等功能
  version: 1.0.0
  contact:
    name: API Support
    email: support@example.com
  license:
    name: MIT
    url: https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT

servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/v1
    description: 生产环境服务器
  - url: https://staging-api.example.com/v1
    description: 测试环境服务器

paths:
  /process/text:
    post:
      operationId: processText
      summary: 文本内容处理
      description: 对文本内容进行智能处理、整理和优化
      tags:
        - 文本处理
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextProcessRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 处理成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextProcessResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: 服务器内部错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /process/data:
    post:
      operationId: processData
      summary: 数据分析处理
      description: 对结构化数据进行智能分析和处理
      tags:
        - 数据处理
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataProcessRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 处理成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataProcessResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /workflow/execute:
    post:
      operationId: executeWorkflow
      summary: 工作流执行
      description: 执行自动化工作流程
      tags:
        - 工作流
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowExecuteRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 执行成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowExecuteResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /unified/automation:
    post:
      operationId: unifiedAutomation
      summary: 统一自动化处理
      description: 集成所有功能的统一自动化处理接口
      tags:
        - 统一自动化
      parameters:
        - name: enableAutoProcessing
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: boolean
            default: true
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 处理成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

components:
  schemas:
    TextProcessRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - content
        - operationType
      properties:
        content:
          type: string
          description: 需要处理的文本内容
          example: "这是需要处理的原始文本内容"
        operationType:
          type: string
          enum: [clean, summarize, format, translate]
          description: 处理类型
          example: "clean"
        options:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProcessingOptions'

    TextProcessResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 处理是否成功
        processedContent:
          type: string
          description: 处理后的文本内容
        statistics:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProcessingStatistics'
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 处理时间戳

    DataProcessRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - data
        - analysisType
      properties:
        data:
          type: object
          description: 需要处理的数据
          example: {"key": "value"}
        analysisType:
          type: string
          enum: [statistical, predictive, clustering, classification]
          description: 分析类型
        parameters:
          type: object
          description: 分析参数

    DataProcessResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
        results:
          type: object
          description: 分析结果
        insights:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: 数据洞察

    WorkflowExecuteRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - workflowId
        - inputData
      properties:
        workflowId:
          type: string
          description: 工作流ID
        inputData:
          type: object
          description: 输入数据
        parameters:
          type: object
          description: 执行参数

    WorkflowExecuteResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
        output:
          type: object
          description: 工作流输出
        executionTime:
          type: number
          description: 执行时间(毫秒)
        steps:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowStep'

    WorkflowStep:
      type: object
      properties:
        stepId:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
        result:
          type: object

    UnifiedAutomationRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - input
        - functions
      properties:
        input:
          type: object
          description: 输入数据
        functions:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: 需要执行的功能列表
        enableAutoProcessing:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
        options:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProcessingOptions'

    UnifiedAutomationResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
        results:
          type: object
          description: 处理结果
        processedFunctions:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: 已处理的功能列表
        summary:
          type: string
          description: 处理摘要
        metadata:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ResponseMetadata'

    ProcessingOptions:
      type: object
      properties:
        language:
          type: string
          default: "zh-CN"
        outputFormat:
          type: string
          enum: [json, text, html]
          default: "json"
        quality:
          type: string
          enum: [standard, high, premium]
          default: "standard"

    ProcessingStatistics:
      type: object
      properties:
        inputLength:
          type: integer
        outputLength:
          type: integer
        processingTime:
          type: number
        changesMade:
          type: integer

    ResponseMetadata:
      type: object
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: string
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        version:
          type: string

    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        code:
          type: string
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          type: object
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time

  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer

security:
  - ApiKeyAuth: []
  - BearerAuth: []

tags:
  - name: 文本处理
    description: 文本内容智能处理功能
  - name: 数据处理
    description: 结构化数据分析处理功能
  - name: 工作流
    description: 自动化工作流执行功能
  - name: 统一自动化
    description: 集成所有功能的统一自动化处理

openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: 企业工作流智能编排系统
  description: 集成30个核心功能模块的统一企业级工作流管理、自动化执行和智能编排平台，支持用户选择是否启用自动化处理
  version: 1.0.0
  contact:
    name: 技术支持团队
    url: https://enterprise-workflow.com
    email: support@enterprise-workflow.com
  license:
    name: 商业许可
    url: https://enterprise-workflow.com/license

servers:
  - url: https://api.enterprise-workflow.com/v1
    description: 生产环境

tags:
  - name: 统一自动化工具
    description: 集成30个核心功能的统一自动化工作流编排工具

paths:
  /automations:
    post:
      tags:
        - 统一自动化工具
      summary: 执行统一自动化操作
      description: 根据操作类型执行相应的自动化处理流程
      operationId: executeUnifiedAutomation
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationRequest'
            examples:
              basicOperation:
                summary: 基础自动化操作示例
                value:
                  operation_type: "process_automation"
                  automation_enabled: true
                  async_execution: false
                  version: "v1.0"
                  operation_config:
                    automation_config:
                      operation_mode: "industry_analysis"
                      optimization_level: "standard"
                      processing_level: "basic"
                      parallel_processing: true
                      error_handling: "adaptive"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 同步操作成功响应
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponse'
        '202':
          description: 异步操作已接受
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncAutomationResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: 未授权访问
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: 服务器内部错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /automations/{operationId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - 统一自动化工具
      summary: 获取操作状态
      description: 查询指定自动化操作的执行状态和结果
      operationId: getAutomationStatus
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: operationId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 操作状态查询成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponse'
        '404':
          description: 操作不存在
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

components:
  schemas:
    UnifiedAutomationRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - operation_type
        - operation_config
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - activate_emergency
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - backup_revert
            - create_custom_node
            - create_workflow
            - delete_workflow
            - execute_workflow
            - feed_data
            - generate_workflow
            - get_data_connections
            - get_workflow_by_id
            - get_workflows
            - process_automation
            - process_luoyang_heritage
            - repair_all_nodes
            - train_model
            - trigger_auto_plugin_workflow
            - update_workflow
            - validate_parameters
          description: 要执行的自动化操作类型
        validation_config:
          type: object
          properties:
            auto_validate:
              type: boolean
              description: 是否自动验证参数
            error_handling:
              type: string
              enum:
                - strict
                - lenient
                - adaptive
              description: 错误处理策略
            validation_strictness:
              type: string
              enum:
                - relaxed
                - standard
                - strict
              description: 验证严格程度
          description: 验证配置
        version:
          type: string
          enum:
            - v1.0
            - v2.0
            - v3.0
          default: v1.0
          description: 功能版本号
        async_execution:
          type: boolean
          default: false
          description: 是否异步执行
        automation_enabled:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
        callback_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 异步回调URL
        operation_config:
          type: object
          description: 自动化操作配置参数
          properties:
            ai_enhancement_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AIEnhancementConfig'
            automation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AutomationConfig'
            backup_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BackupConfig'
            connection_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConnectionConfig'
            custom_node_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomNodeConfig'
            emergency_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmergencyConfig'
            heritage_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/HeritageConfig'
            industry_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/IndustryConfig'
            plugin_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PluginConfig'
            query_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryConfig'
            repair_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RepairConfig'
            training_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TrainingConfig'
            validation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationConfig'
            workflow_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig'

    UnifiedAutomationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 统一自动化操作响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 自动化操作是否成功
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - completed
            - processing
            - failed
            - accepted
            - partially_completed
          description: 操作状态
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
        automation_enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用了自动化处理
        automation_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - none
            - low
            - medium
            - high
            - full
          description: 自动化处理级别
        execution_time:
          type: number
          description: 执行时间（秒）
        processed_steps:
          type: integer
          description: 自动化处理的步骤数量
        result:
          type: object
          description: 自动化操作结果数据
        error:
          type: object
          description: 错误信息
          properties:
            code:
              type: string
              description: 错误代码标识
            message:
              type: string
              description: 错误消息描述
            details:
              type: object
              description: 错误详细信息
        next_actions:
          type: array
          description: 建议的下一步操作
          items:
            type: string
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL（异步操作）
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 响应时间戳

    AsyncAutomationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 异步自动化操作响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 自动化操作是否成功接受
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - accepted
          description: 操作状态
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
        automation_enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用了自动化处理
        estimated_completion:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 预计完成时间
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL

    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      description: 统一错误响应格式
      required:
        - error_code
        - message
      properties:
        error_code:
          type: string
          enum:
            - INVALID_PARAMS
            - UNAUTHORIZED
            - OPERATION_NOT_FOUND
            - SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
            - RATE_LIMITED
            - INTERNAL_ERROR
          description: 标准化错误代码
        message:
          type: string
          description: 用户可读的错误消息
        details:
          type: object
          description: 错误详细信息
        request_id:
          type: string
          description: 请求唯一标识符
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 错误发生时间戳

    AIEnhancementConfig:
      type: object
      description: AI增强功能配置参数
      properties:
        enhancement_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - cleaning
            - enrichment
            - completion
            - quality_improvement
          description: 数据增强类型
        input_data:
          type: string
          description: 输入数据内容
        batch_data:
          type: array
          description: 批量处理的数据集合
          items:
            type: object
        options:
          type: object
          description: 增强处理选项配置
        output_format:
          type: string
          enum:
            - json
            - xml
            - csv
            - text
          description: 输出数据格式

    AutomationConfig:
      type: object
      description: 自动化处理配置参数
      properties:
        operation_mode:
          type: string
          enum:
            - industry_analysis
            - workflow_generation
            - auto_repair
            - luoyang_heritage
            - custom
          description: 自动化操作模式
        optimization_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - standard
            - optimized
            - max_performance
          description: 优化级别设置
        processing_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - advanced
            - comprehensive
          description: 数据处理深度级别
        parallel_processing:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用并行处理
        error_handling:
          type: string
          enum:
            - strict
            - lenient
            - adaptive
          description: 错误处理策略
        input_data:
          type: object
          description: 输入数据对象
        input_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 输入参数配置
        output_format:
          type: string
          description: 输出格式定义

    BackupConfig:
      type: object
      description: 数据备份和恢复配置
      properties:
        target_components:
          type: array
          description: 目标组件列表
          items:
            type: string
        revert_scope:
          type: string
          enum:
            - full
            - partial
            - data_only
          description: 回滚操作范围
        revert_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - full
            - incremental
            - selective
          description: 回滚类型
        conflict_resolution:
          type: string
          enum:
            - overwrite
            - merge
            - skip
          description: 数据冲突解决策略
        preview_changes:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否预览变更内容
        rollback_plan:
          type: string
          description: 回滚计划描述
        backup_id:
          type: string
          description: 备份记录唯一标识
        confirmation_required:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作前是否需要确认

    ConnectionConfig:
      type: object
      description: 数据连接配置参数
      properties:
        connection_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - all
            - database
            - api
            - file
            - streaming
          description: 连接类型筛选
        include_details:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含详细连接信息
        status_filter:
          type: string
          enum:
            - all
            - active
            - inactive
            - error
          description: 连接状态过滤条件

    CustomNodeConfig:
      type: object
      description: 自定义节点配置参数
      properties:
        node_name:
          type: string
          description: 节点名称标识
        node_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - code
            - plugin
            - metadata
          description: 节点类型分类
        description:
          type: string
          description: 节点功能描述
        programming_language:
          type: string
          enum:
            - python
            - javascript
            - typescript
          description: 编程语言类型
        code_content:
          type: string
          description: 节点代码内容
        configuration:
          type: object
          description: 节点配置信息
        dependencies:
          type: array
          description: 依赖项列表
          items:
            type: string

    EmergencyConfig:
      type: object
      description: 应急处理配置参数
      properties:
        emergency_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - low
            - medium
            - high
            - critical
            - level1
            - level2
            - level3
            - level4
          description: 应急事件级别
        notification_contacts:
          type: array
          description: 紧急通知联系人列表
          items:
            type: string
            format: email
        recovery_strategy:
          type: string
          enum:
            - immediate
            - gradual
            - manual
          description: 系统恢复策略
        activation_reason:
          type: string
          description: 应急机制激活原因
        auto_recovery:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动恢复

    HeritageConfig:
      type: object
      description: 文化遗产数据处理配置
      properties:
        action_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - query
            - register
            - update
            - preserve
          description: 文化遗产操作类型
        heritage_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - intangible
            - tangible
            - cultural_practice
          description: 文化遗产类型
        heritage_category:
          type: string
          enum:
            - traditional_craft
            - performing_arts
            - rituals
            - oral_traditions
          description: 文化遗产分类
        heritage_data:
          type: object
          description: 文化遗产数据内容
        digital_assets:
          type: array
          description: 数字资产资源列表
          items:
            type: string
        cultural_context:
          type: object
          description: 文化背景信息
        location:
          type: string
          description: 文化遗产地理位置
        preservation_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - standard
            - premium
          description: 文化遗产保护级别
        processing_mode:
          type: string
          enum:
            - cataloging
            - digital_preservation
            - public_display
            - research
          description: 文化遗产处理模式

    IndustryConfig:
      type: object
      description: 行业分析配置参数
      properties:
        industry_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - manufacturing
            - retail
            - healthcare
            - finance
            - education
          description: 行业类型分类
        industry_name:
          type: string
          description: 行业名称标识
        analysis_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - classification
            - trends
            - competitive
            - risk
          description: 行业分析类型
        analysis_depth:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - standard
            - comprehensive
          description: 行业分析深度
        time_period:
          type: string
          description: 分析时间段
        forecast_period:
          type: string
          description: 行业预测周期
        include_forecast:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含预测分析
        include_trends:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含趋势分析
        comparison_metrics:
          type: array
          description: 行业比较指标
          items:
            type: string
        data_sources:
          type: array
          description: 行业数据来源
          items:
            type: string
        region:
          type: string
          description: 目标区域范围
        geographic_scope:
          type: string
          description: 地理分析范围

    PluginConfig:
      type: object
      description: 插件功能配置参数
      properties:
        plugin_description:
          type: string
          description: 插件功能描述
        node_types:
          type: array
          description: 支持的节点类型
          items:
            type: string
        execution_priority:
          type: string
          enum:
            - low
            - normal
            - high
            - critical
          description: 插件执行优先级
        self_healing_enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自愈功能
        trigger_conditions:
          type: object
          description: 插件触发条件

    QueryConfig:
      type: object
      description: 数据查询配置参数
      properties:
        page_number:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: 查询页码
        page_size:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 100
          description: 每页记录数
        sort_by:
          type: string
          enum:
            - name
            - created_date
            - modified_date
          description: 结果排序字段
        filter_by_status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - all
            - active
            - inactive
            - draft
          description: 状态过滤条件
        include_execution_history:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含执行历史
        include_node_details:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含节点详情

    RepairConfig:
      type: object
      description: 系统修复配置参数
      properties:
        repair_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - system
            - network
            - database
            - application
            - performance
          description: 修复类型分类
        repair_scope:
          type: string
          enum:
            - configuration
            - logic
            - dependencies
            - all
          description: 修复操作范围
        repair_strategy:
          type: string
          enum:
            - auto
            - semi_auto
            - manual_approval
          description: 修复策略选择
        diagnosis_mode:
          type: string
          enum:
            - quick
            - deep
            - predictive
          description: 诊断模式选择
        diagnosis_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - quick
            - standard
            - comprehensive
            - deep
            - predictive
          description: 问题诊断深度
        target_components:
          type: array
          description: 目标修复组件
          items:
            type: string
        auto_execute:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否自动执行修复
        backup_before_repair:
          type: boolean
          description: 修复前是否备份

    TrainingConfig:
      type: object
      description: 模型训练配置参数
      properties:
        model_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - classification
            - regression
            - clustering
            - nlp
          description: 机器学习模型类型
        model_target:
          type: string
          description: 模型训练目标
        training_data:
          type: string
          description: 训练数据内容
        training_dataset:
          type: string
          description: 训练数据集标识
        data_format:
          type: string
          enum:
            - json
            - csv
            - text
            - image
          description: 训练数据格式
        training_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 训练参数配置
        validation_split:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1
          description: 验证集分割比例
        data_quality_check:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否进行数据质量检查
        hyperparameter_tuning:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否进行超参数调优
        preprocessing:
          type: object
          description: 数据预处理配置

    ValidationConfig:
      type: object
      description: 参数验证配置
      properties:
        validation_rules:
          type: object
          description: 验证规则定义
        parameters_to_validate:
          type: object
          description: 待验证参数集合
        context:
          type: object
          description: 验证上下文信息
        strict_mode:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用严格验证模式

    WorkflowConfig:
      type: object
      description: 工作流配置参数
      properties:
        workflow_id:
          type: string
          description: 工作流唯一标识
        workflow_name:
          type: string
          description: 工作流名称
        business_domain:
          type: string
          enum:
            - ecommerce
            - industry
            - programming
            - finance
            - healthcare
            - manufacturing
            - retail
            - education
          description: 业务领域分类
        description:
          type: string
          description: 工作流描述信息
        requirement_description:
          type: string
          description: 需求描述文档
        complexity_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - simple
            - medium
            - complex
          description: 工作流复杂度级别
        nodes:
          type: array
          description: 工作流节点列表
          items:
            type: object
        triggers:
          type: array
          description: 触发器配置列表
          items:
            type: object
        execution_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 执行参数配置
        monitoring_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - detailed
            - verbose
          description: 监控详细程度
        result_format:
          type: string
          enum:
            - summary
            - detailed
            - raw
          description: 结果输出格式
        validation_strictness:
          type: string
          enum:
            - relaxed
            - standard
            - strict
          description: 验证严格程度
        update_operations:
          type: array
          description: 更新操作列表
          items:
            type: object
        tags:
          type: array
          description: 工作流标签分类
          items:
            type: string
        version_comment:
          type: string
          description: 版本更新说明

  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: 使用JWT Bearer Token进行认证

security:
  - bearerAuth: []
第七部分：全场景智能自动化超级中枢（OpenAPI 3.1.0完整版）
