openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: 全场景智能自动化超级中枢 - 统一架构
  version: 20.0.0-Complete-Unified
  description: |
    🚀 完全统一的单一智能自动化工具 - 深度整合所有功能模块
    ✅ 单一端点处理所有58项核心功能 | ✅ 智能路由决策 | ✅ 全链路监控
    ✅ 企业级稳定性 | ✅ 支持自然语言和参数化两种模式
    
    📊 核心功能架构:
    1. 文本智能处理引擎 (清洁、摘要、格式化、翻译)
    2. 高级数据分析模块 (统计、预测、聚类、分类)
    3. 可视化工作流系统 (设计、编排、执行、监控)
    4. 统一自动化网关 (智能路由、动态组合、自适应策略)
    5. 企业工作流智能编排系统 (30个核心功能模块)
    6. 文化遗产数字化处理 (洛阳遗产保护系统)
    7. AI增强处理引擎 (质量提升、内容增强)
    8. 应急响应与系统修复机制
    
    🔧 技术特性:
    · RESTful API设计 - 符合行业标准
    · Schema验证 - 严格的参数校验
    · 扩展性架构 - 模块化设计，易于功能扩展
    · 兼容性保证 - 完全兼容Coze平台规范
    · 双重认证机制 - API Key + Bearer Token
    · 多环境支持 - 开发、测试、生产环境
  contact:
    name: 全场景智能自动化技术支持团队
    url: https://universal-automation.com
    email: support@universal-automation.com
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html
externalDocs:
  description: 全场景智能自动化引擎完整文档
  url: https://docs.universal-automation.com

servers:
  - url: https://api.universal-automation.com/v1
    description: 生产环境API端点
  - url: https://staging-api.universal-automation.com/v1
    description: 测试环境API端点
  - url: https://dev-api.universal-automation.com/v1
    description: 开发环境API端点

tags:
  - name: 统一智能自动化
    description: 单一工具处理所有自动化功能，支持58项核心操作
  - name: 文本处理
    description: 文本内容智能处理功能 (清洁、摘要、格式化、翻译)
  - name: 数据处理
    description: 结构化数据分析处理功能 (统计、预测、聚类、分类)
  - name: 工作流
    description: 自动化工作流执行功能
  - name: 统一自动化工具
    description: 集成30个核心功能的统一自动化工作流编排工具
  - name: 系统监控
    description: 操作状态监控、健康检查和管理
  - name: 参数验证
    description: 参数验证和智能修复

paths:
  # ==================== 核心统一自动化执行端点 ====================
  /unified-automation:
    post:
      summary: 统一自动化执行端点 (核心接口)
      description: |
        单一端点处理所有自动化功能，支持智能路由和自动参数处理
        
        💡 **使用模式选择**：
        - **简单模式**：使用自然语言描述需求，系统自动分析并执行
        - **专业模式**：使用结构化参数精确控制执行流程
        
        📋 **支持的全部功能类型 (58项)**：
        1. 文本处理: clean, summarize, format, translate
        2. 数据分析: statistical, predictive, clustering, classification
        3. 工作流管理: create_workflow, execute_workflow, update_workflow, delete_workflow
        4. AI增强: activate_emergency, ai_enhancement, auto_repair, backup_revert
        5. 系统管理: create_custom_node, feed_data, generate_workflow, get_data_connections
        6. 行业分析: analyze_industry, process_automation
        7. 文化遗产: process_luoyang_heritage
        8. 模型训练: train_model
        9. 插件系统: trigger_auto_plugin_workflow
        10. 参数验证: validate_parameters
      tags:
        - 统一智能自动化
        - 文本处理
        - 数据处理
        - 工作流
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
        - ApiKeyAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SimpleUserRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProfessionalRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextProcessRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataProcessRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowExecuteRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationRequest'
            examples:
              文本处理示例:
                summary: 文本处理功能示例
                value:
                  content: "这是需要处理的原始文本内容，包含一些冗余信息和格式问题。"
                  operationType: "clean"
                  options:
                    language: "zh-CN"
                    outputFormat: "text"
                    quality: "standard"
                  enable_automation: true
              数据分析示例:
                summary: 数据分析功能示例
                value:
                  data: {"sales": [100, 200, 150, 300], "customers": [50, 80, 60, 100]}
                  analysisType: "statistical"
                  parameters: {"method": "regression", "confidence": 0.95}
                  enable_automation: true
              工作流执行示例:
                summary: 工作流执行功能示例
                value:
                  workflowId: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                  inputData: {"order_id": "ORD12345", "customer": "张三", "amount": 299.99}
                  parameters: {"priority": "high", "notify": true}
                  enable_automation: true
              简单模式示例:
                summary: 简单自然语言模式（推荐新手）
                value:
                  user_request: "帮我创建一个电商订单处理工作流，包含订单确认、库存检查、物流通知功能"
                  timeout: 300
                  enable_automation: true
              专业模式示例:
                summary: 专业参数模式（推荐开发者）
                value:
                  operation_type: "generate_workflow"
                  operation_config:
                    workflow_config:
                      business_domain: "ecommerce"
                      complexity_level: "medium"
                      requirement_description: "生成电商订单自动发货工作流"
                  async_execution: false
                  version: "v3.0"
                  enable_automation: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 同步操作成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedSuccessResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextProcessResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataProcessResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowExecuteResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponse'
              examples:
                文本处理成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    processedContent: "这是处理后的文本内容，格式整洁。"
                    statistics:
                      inputLength: 35
                      outputLength: 18
                      processingTime: 0.15
                      changesMade: 5
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                数据分析成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    results:
                      mean_sales: 187.5
                      mean_customers: 72.5
                      correlation: 0.98
                    insights:
                      - "销售与客户数量高度相关"
                      - "建议增加营销投入以获取更多客户"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:21:00Z"
                工作流执行成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    output:
                      order_status: "processed"
                      inventory_check: "passed"
                      shipping_notified: true
                    executionTime: 1200
                    steps:
                      - stepId: "order_validation"
                        status: "completed"
                        result: {"valid": true}
                      - stepId: "inventory_check"
                        status: "completed"
                        result: {"available": true, "quantity": 50}
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:22:00Z"
                工作流生成成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    execution_time: 2.5
                    result_data:
                      workflow_id: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                      workflow_name: "电商订单自动发货流程"
                      status: "created"
                数据处理成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_9e3f5d7c2b4a6e8d"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:21:00Z"
                    execution_time: 1.2
                    result_data:
                      processed_items: 1500
                      quality_score: 0.95
                      enhancement_report: {}
        '202':
          description: 异步操作已接受
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncOperationResponse'
              examples:
                异步操作接受:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "accepted"
                    monitor_url: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    estimated_completion: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        '400':
          description: 参数验证失败
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
              examples:
                参数错误:
                  value:
                    code: 4001
                    message: "参数验证失败"
                    errors:
                      - field: "parameters.demand"
                        message: "长度需大于10个字符"
                        value: "生成工作流"
                        suggestion: "请提供更详细的需求描述"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:22:00Z"
                    request_id: "req_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    documentation_url: "https://docs.universal-automation.com/errors/4001"
        '500':
          description: 服务器内部错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  # ==================== 传统API端点（兼容性保留） ====================
  /process/text:
    post:
      operationId: processText
      summary: 文本内容处理
      description: 对文本内容进行智能处理、整理和优化
      tags:
        - 文本处理
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
        - ApiKeyAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextProcessRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 处理成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextProcessResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /process/data:
    post:
      operationId: processData
      summary: 数据分析处理
      description: 对结构化数据进行智能分析和处理
      tags:
        - 数据处理
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
        - ApiKeyAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataProcessRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 处理成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/DataProcessResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /workflow/execute:
    post:
      operationId: executeWorkflow
      summary: 工作流执行
      description: 执行自动化工作流程
      tags:
        - 工作流
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
        - ApiKeyAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowExecuteRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 执行成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowExecuteResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /automations:
    post:
      tags:
        - 统一自动化工具
      summary: 执行统一自动化操作（传统端点）
      description: 根据操作类型执行相应的自动化处理流程
      operationId: executeUnifiedAutomation
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationRequestV2'
            examples:
              basicOperation:
                summary: 基础自动化操作示例
                value:
                  operation_type: "process_automation"
                  automation_enabled: true
                  async_execution: false
                  version: "v1.0"
                  operation_config:
                    automation_config:
                      operation_mode: "industry_analysis"
                      optimization_level: "standard"
                      processing_level: "basic"
                      parallel_processing: true
                      error_handling: "adaptive"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 同步操作成功响应
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponseV2'
        '202':
          description: 异步操作已接受
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncAutomationResponse'
        '400':
          description: 请求参数错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: 未授权访问
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: 服务器内部错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  # ==================== 系统监控与管理端点 ====================
  /operations/{operation_id}:
    get:
      summary: 获取操作状态和结果
      description: 查询异步操作的执行状态、进度和最终结果
      tags:
        - 系统监控
      parameters:
        - name: operation_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 操作状态信息
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OperationStatus'
              examples:
                处理中状态:
                  value:
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "processing"
                    progress: 75
                    created_at: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    updated_at: "2025-11-07T14:22:30Z"
                    estimated_remaining: 45.5
                完成状态:
                  value:
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "completed"
                    progress: 100
                    created_at: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    updated_at: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
                    result:
                      workflow_id: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                      workflow_name: "电商订单自动发货流程"
        '404':
          description: 操作不存在
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /health:
    get:
      summary: 系统健康状态检查
      description: 检查系统各组件的健康状态和性能指标
      tags:
        - 系统监控
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 系统健康状态报告
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthStatus'
              examples:
                健康状态:
                  value:
                    status: "healthy"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    uptime: 86400
                    version: "20.0.0-Complete-Unified"
                    components:
                      database: "connected"
                      workflow_engine: "up"
                      ai_services: "up"
                      plugin_system: "up"
                    performance_metrics:
                      response_time: 150
                      throughput: 120
                      error_rate: 0.01
                    recommendations:
                      - "建议定期清理缓存"
        '503':
          description: 服务不可用
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /validate:
    post:
      summary: 参数验证服务
      description: 验证操作参数的完整性和正确性，提供修复建议
      tags:
        - 参数验证
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationRequest'
            examples:
              验证请求:
                value:
                  operation_type: "generate_workflow"
                  parameters:
                    demand: "生成工作流"
                    industry: "电商"
                  validation_strictness: "strict"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 验证结果
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationResponse'
              examples:
                验证成功:
                  value:
                    valid: true
                    errors: []
                    warnings: []
                    suggestions: ["建议增加数据验证步骤", "推荐使用更高的分析深度"]
                    auto_fix_applied: false
                验证失败:
                  value:
                    valid: false
                    errors:
                      - field: "parameters.demand"
                        message: "长度需大于10个字符"
                        code: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
                    warnings: []
                    suggestions: ["请提供更详细的需求描述"]
                    auto_fix_applied: false

  /automations/{operationId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - 统一自动化工具
        - 系统监控
      summary: 获取操作状态（传统端点）
      description: 查询指定自动化操作的执行状态和结果
      operationId: getAutomationStatus
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: operationId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 操作状态查询成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponseV2'
        '404':
          description: 操作不存在
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

components:
  schemas:
    # ==================== 核心请求对象 ====================
    SimpleUserRequest:
      type: object
      description: 简单用户请求模式 - 使用自然语言描述需求
      properties:
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: 用户自然语言需求描述（系统自动分析并执行）
          minLength: 10
          maxLength: 2000
          example: "帮我创建一个电商订单处理工作流，包含订单确认、库存检查、物流通知功能"
        preferred_action:
          type: string
          description: 用户偏好的功能类型（可选）
          enum:
            - generate_workflow
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - process_luoyang_heritage
          example: generate_workflow
        timeout:
          type: integer
          description: 执行超时时间（10-3600秒）
          default: 300
          minimum: 10
          maximum: 3600
          example: 300
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true
          example: true
      required:
        - user_request

    ProfessionalRequest:
      type: object
      description: 专业请求模式 - 使用结构化参数精确控制
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 操作类型
          enum:
            - activate_emergency
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - backup_revert
            - create_custom_node
            - create_workflow
            - delete_workflow
            - execute_workflow
            - feed_data
            - generate_workflow
            - get_data_connections
            - get_workflow_by_id
            - get_workflows
            - process_automation
            - process_luoyang_heritage
            - repair_all_nodes
            - train_model
            - trigger_auto_plugin_workflow
            - update_workflow
            - validate_parameters
          example: generate_workflow
        operation_config:
          type: object
          description: 操作配置参数
          properties:
            workflow_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig'
            ai_enhancement_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AIEnhancementConfig'
            automation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AutomationConfig'
            backup_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BackupConfig'
            connection_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConnectionConfig'
            custom_node_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomNodeConfig'
            emergency_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmergencyConfig'
            heritage_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/HeritageConfig'
            industry_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/IndustryConfig'
            plugin_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PluginConfig'
            query_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryConfig'
            repair_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RepairConfig'
            training_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TrainingConfig'
            validation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationConfig'
        async_execution:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否异步执行
          default: false
        callback_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 异步回调URL
          example: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/callbacks/operation-complete"
        version:
          type: string
          description: API版本
          default: v3.0
          enum:
            - v1.0
            - v2.0
            - v3.0
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true
        timeout:
          type: integer
          description: 执行超时时间（秒）
          default: 300
          minimum: 10
          maximum: 3600
      required:
        - operation_type
        - operation_config

    # ==================== 传统API请求对象 ====================
    TextProcessRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - content
        - operationType
      properties:
        content:
          type: string
          description: 需要处理的文本内容
          example: "这是需要处理的原始文本内容"
        operationType:
          type: string
          enum: [clean, summarize, format, translate]
          description: 处理类型
          example: "clean"
        options:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProcessingOptions'
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true

    DataProcessRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - data
        - analysisType
      properties:
        data:
          type: object
          description: 需要处理的数据
          example: {"key": "value"}
        analysisType:
          type: string
          enum: [statistical, predictive, clustering, classification]
          description: 分析类型
        parameters:
          type: object
          description: 分析参数
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true

    WorkflowExecuteRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - workflowId
        - inputData
      properties:
        workflowId:
          type: string
          description: 工作流ID
        inputData:
          type: object
          description: 输入数据
        parameters:
          type: object
          description: 执行参数
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true

    UnifiedAutomationRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - input
        - functions
      properties:
        input:
          type: object
          description: 输入数据
        functions:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: 需要执行的功能列表
        enableAutoProcessing:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
        options:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProcessingOptions'

    UnifiedAutomationRequestV2:
      type: object
      required:
        - operation_type
        - operation_config
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - activate_emergency
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - backup_revert
            - create_custom_node
            - create_workflow
            - delete_workflow
            - execute_workflow
            - feed_data
            - generate_workflow
            - get_data_connections
            - get_workflow_by_id
            - get_workflows
            - process_automation
            - process_luoyang_heritage
            - repair_all_nodes
            - train_model
            - trigger_auto_plugin_workflow
            - update_workflow
            - validate_parameters
          description: 要执行的自动化操作类型
        validation_config:
          type: object
          properties:
            auto_validate:
              type: boolean
              description: 是否自动验证参数
            error_handling:
              type: string
              enum:
                - strict
                - lenient
                - adaptive
              description: 错误处理策略
            validation_strictness:
              type: string
              enum:
                - relaxed
                - standard
                - strict
              description: 验证严格程度
          description: 验证配置
        version:
          type: string
          enum:
            - v1.0
            - v2.0
            - v3.0
          default: v1.0
          description: 功能版本号
        async_execution:
          type: boolean
          default: false
          description: 是否异步执行
        automation_enabled:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
        callback_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 异步回调URL
        operation_config:
          type: object
          description: 自动化操作配置参数
          properties:
            ai_enhancement_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AIEnhancementConfig'
            automation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AutomationConfig'
            backup_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BackupConfig'
            connection_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConnectionConfig'
            custom_node_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomNodeConfig'
            emergency_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmergencyConfig'
            heritage_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/HeritageConfig'
            industry_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/IndustryConfig'
            plugin_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PluginConfig'
            query_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryConfig'
            repair_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RepairConfig'
            training_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TrainingConfig'
            validation_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationConfig'
            workflow_config:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig'

    ValidationRequest:
      type: object
      description: 参数验证请求
      properties:
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: 要验证的操作类型
          enum:
            - activate_emergency
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - backup_revert
            - create_custom_node
            - create_workflow
            - delete_workflow
            - execute_workflow
            - feed_data
            - generate_workflow
            - get_data_connections
            - get_workflow_by_id
            - get_workflows
            - process_automation
            - process_luoyang_heritage
            - repair_all_nodes
            - train_model
            - trigger_auto_plugin_workflow
            - update_workflow
        parameters:
          type: object
          description: 要验证的参数对象
        validation_strictness:
          type: string
          description: 验证严格程度
          enum:
            - relaxed
            - standard
            - strict
          default: standard
      required:
        - operation_type
        - parameters

    # ==================== 核心响应对象 ====================
    UnifiedSuccessResponse:
      type: object
      description: 统一成功响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作是否成功
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 响应时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        execution_time:
          type: number
          description: 执行时间（秒）
          example: 2.5
        result_data:
          type: object
          description: 操作结果数据
          properties:
            workflow_id:
              type: string
              description: 工作流ID
              example: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
            workflow_name:
              type: string
              description: 工作流名称
              example: "电商订单自动发货流程"
            processed_items:
              type: integer
              description: 处理的项目数量
              example: 1500
            quality_score:
              type: number
              description: 质量评分
              example: 0.95
            enhancement_report:
              type: object
              description: 增强报告
          additionalProperties: true
        automation_applied:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否应用了自动化处理
          example: true
      required:
        - success
        - operation_id
        - timestamp

    # ==================== 传统API响应对象 ====================
    TextProcessResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 处理是否成功
        processedContent:
          type: string
          description: 处理后的文本内容
        statistics:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProcessingStatistics'
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 处理时间戳

    DataProcessResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
        results:
          type: object
          description: 分析结果
        insights:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: 数据洞察
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 处理时间戳

    WorkflowExecuteResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
        output:
          type: object
          description: 工作流输出
        executionTime:
          type: number
          description: 执行时间(毫秒)
        steps:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkflowStep'
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 处理时间戳

    UnifiedAutomationResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
        results:
          type: object
          description: 处理结果
        processedFunctions:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: 已处理的功能列表
        summary:
          type: string
          description: 处理摘要
        metadata:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ResponseMetadata'

    UnifiedAutomationResponseV2:
      type: object
      description: 统一自动化操作响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 自动化操作是否成功
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - completed
            - processing
            - failed
            - accepted
            - partially_completed
          description: 操作状态
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
        automation_enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用了自动化处理
        automation_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - none
            - low
            - medium
            - high
            - full
          description: 自动化处理级别
        execution_time:
          type: number
          description: 执行时间（秒）
        processed_steps:
          type: integer
          description: 自动化处理的步骤数量
        result:
          type: object
          description: 自动化操作结果数据
        error:
          type: object
          description: 错误信息
          properties:
            code:
              type: string
              description: 错误代码标识
            message:
              type: string
              description: 错误消息描述
            details:
              type: object
              description: 错误详细信息
        next_actions:
          type: array
          description: 建议的下一步操作
          items:
            type: string
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL（异步操作）
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 响应时间戳

    AsyncOperationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 异步操作响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作是否成功接受
          default: true
          example: true
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        status:
          type: string
          description: 操作状态
          enum:
            - accepted
          example: accepted
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL
          example: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        estimated_completion:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 预计完成时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 响应时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
      required:
        - success
        - operation_id
        - status
        - monitor_url
        - timestamp

    AsyncAutomationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 异步自动化操作响应
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: 自动化操作是否成功接受
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - accepted
          description: 操作状态
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
        automation_enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用了自动化处理
        estimated_completion:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 预计完成时间
        monitor_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: 监控URL

    OperationStatus:
      type: object
      description: 操作状态信息
      properties:
        operation_id:
          type: string
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
        status:
          type: string
          description: 操作状态
          enum:
            - pending
            - processing
            - completed
            - failed
            - cancelled
          example: processing
        progress:
          type: integer
          description: 执行进度（0-100）
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
          example: 75
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 创建时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 最后更新时间
          example: "2025-11-07T14:22:30Z"
        estimated_remaining:
          type: number
          description: 预计剩余时间（秒）
          example: 45.5
        result:
          type: object
          description: 操作结果（仅当状态为completed时存在）
        error:
          type: object
          description: 错误信息（仅当状态为failed时存在）
          properties:
            error_code:
              type: string
              description: 错误代码
              example: "WORKFLOW_GENERATION_FAILED"
            error_message:
              type: string
              description: 错误信息
              example: "工作流生成失败：需求描述不清晰"
            error_details:
              type: object
              description: 错误详情
      required:
        - operation_id
        - status
        - created_at

    HealthStatus:
      type: object
      description: 系统健康状态
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          description: 整体健康状态
          enum:
            - healthy
            - degraded
            - unhealthy
          example: healthy
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 检查时间戳
          example: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        uptime:
          type: number
          description: 系统运行时间（秒）
          example: 86400
        version:
          type: string
          description: 系统版本
          example: "20.0.0-Complete-Unified"
        components:
          type: object
          description: 组件健康状态
          properties:
            database:
              type: string
              description: 数据库状态
              enum:
                - connected
                - disconnected
              example: connected
            workflow_engine:
              type: string
              description: 工作流引擎状态
              enum:
                - up
                - down
                - degraded
              example: up
            ai_services:
              type: string
              description: AI服务状态
              enum:
                - up
                - down
                - degraded
              example: up
            plugin_system:
              type: string
              description: 插件系统状态
              enum:
                - up
                - down
                - degraded
              example: up
        performance_metrics:
          type: object
          description: 性能指标
          properties:
            response_time:
              type: number
              description: 平均响应时间（毫秒）
              example: 150
            throughput:
              type: number
              description: 每秒处理请求数
              example: 120
            error_rate:
              type: number
              description: 错误率
              example: 0.01
        recommendations:
          type: array
          description: 系统建议
          items:
            type: string
          example: ["建议定期清理缓存", "考虑升级数据库配置"]
      required:
        - status
        - timestamp

    ValidationResponse:
      type: object
      description: 参数验证响应
      properties:
        valid:
          type: boolean
          description: 参数是否有效
          example: true
        errors:
          type: array
          description: 验证错误列表
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
                description: 错误字段路径
                example: "parameters.demand"
              message:
                type: string
                description: 错误信息
                example: "长度需大于10个字符"
              code:
                type: string
                description: 错误代码
                example: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
          example: []
        warnings:
          type: array
          description: 警告信息列表
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
                description: 警告字段路径
                example: "parameters.industry"
              message:
                type: string
                description: 警告信息
                example: "建议指定更具体的行业类型"
          example: []
        suggestions:
          type: array
          description: 改进建议
          items:
            type: string
          example: ["建议增加数据验证步骤", "推荐使用更高的分析深度"]
        auto_fix_applied:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否应用了自动修复
          example: false
      required:
        - valid

    # ==================== 辅助对象 ====================
    WorkflowStep:
      type: object
      properties:
        stepId:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
        result:
          type: object

    ProcessingOptions:
      type: object
      properties:
        language:
          type: string
          default: "zh-CN"
        outputFormat:
          type: string
          enum: [json, text, html]
          default: "json"
        quality:
          type: string
          enum: [standard, high, premium]
          default: "standard"

    ProcessingStatistics:
      type: object
      properties:
        inputLength:
          type: integer
        outputLength:
          type: integer
        processingTime:
          type: number
        changesMade:
          type: integer

    ResponseMetadata:
      type: object
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: string
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        version:
          type: string

    # ==================== 错误响应对象 ====================
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        code:
          type: string
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          type: object
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    ErrorResponseV2:
      type: object
      description: 统一错误响应格式
      required:
        - error_code
        - message
      properties:
        error_code:
          type: string
          enum:
            - INVALID_PARAMS
            - UNAUTHORIZED
            - OPERATION_NOT_FOUND
            - SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
            - RATE_LIMITED
            - INTERNAL_ERROR
          description: 标准化错误代码
        message:
          type: string
          description: 用户可读的错误消息
        details:
          type: object
          description: 错误详细信息
        request_id:
          type: string
          description: 请求唯一标识符
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 错误发生时间戳

    # ==================== 配置对象 ====================
    WorkflowConfig:
      type: object
      description: 工作流配置
      properties:
        business_domain:
          type: string
          description: 业务领域
          enum:
            - ecommerce
            - industry
            - programming
            - finance
            - healthcare
            - manufacturing
            - retail
            - education
          example: ecommerce
        complexity_level:
          type: string
          description: 复杂度级别
          enum:
            - simple
            - medium
            - complex
          example: medium
        requirement_description:
          type: string
          description: 需求描述
          example: "生成电商订单自动发货工作流"
        workflow_name:
          type: string
          description: 工作流名称
          example: "电商订单处理流程"
        workflow_id:
          type: string
          description: 工作流唯一标识
        description:
          type: string
          description: 工作流描述信息
        nodes:
          type: array
          description: 工作流节点列表
          items:
            type: object
        triggers:
          type: array
          description: 触发器配置列表
          items:
            type: object
        execution_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 执行参数配置
        monitoring_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - detailed
            - verbose
          description: 监控详细程度
        update_operations:
          type: array
          description: 更新操作列表
          items:
            type: object
        tags:
          type: array
          description: 工作流标签分类
          items:
            type: string
        version_comment:
          type: string
          description: 版本更新说明

    AIEnhancementConfig:
      type: object
      description: AI增强配置参数
      properties:
        enhancement_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - cleaning
            - enrichment
            - completion
            - quality_improvement
          description: 数据增强类型
        input_data:
          type: string
          description: 输入数据内容
        batch_data:
          type: array
          description: 批量处理的数据集合
          items:
            type: object
        options:
          type: object
          description: 增强处理选项配置
        output_format:
          type: string
          enum:
            - json
            - xml
            - csv
            - text
          description: 输出数据格式

    AutomationConfig:
      type: object
      description: 自动化处理配置参数
      properties:
        operation_mode:
          type: string
          enum:
            - industry_analysis
            - workflow_generation
            - auto_repair
            - luoyang_heritage
            - custom
          description: 自动化操作模式
        optimization_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - standard
            - optimized
            - max_performance
          description: 优化级别设置
        processing_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - advanced
            - comprehensive
          description: 数据处理深度级别
        parallel_processing:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用并行处理
        error_handling:
          type: string
          enum:
            - strict
            - lenient
            - adaptive
          description: 错误处理策略
        input_data:
          type: object
          description: 输入数据对象
        input_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 输入参数配置
        output_format:
          type: string
          description: 输出格式定义

    BackupConfig:
      type: object
      description: 数据备份和恢复配置
      properties:
        target_components:
          type: array
          description: 目标组件列表
          items:
            type: string
        revert_scope:
          type: string
          enum:
            - full
            - partial
            - data_only
          description: 回滚操作范围
        revert_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - full
            - incremental
            - selective
          description: 回滚类型
        conflict_resolution:
          type: string
          enum:
            - overwrite
            - merge
            - skip
          description: 数据冲突解决策略
        preview_changes:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否预览变更内容
        rollback_plan:
          type: string
          description: 回滚计划描述
        backup_id:
          type: string
          description: 备份记录唯一标识
        confirmation_required:
          type: boolean
          description: 操作前是否需要确认

    ConnectionConfig:
      type: object
      description: 数据连接配置参数
      properties:
        connection_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - all
            - database
            - api
            - file
            - streaming
          description: 连接类型筛选
        include_details:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含详细连接信息
        status_filter:
          type: string
          enum:
            - all
            - active
            - inactive
            - error
          description: 连接状态过滤条件

    CustomNodeConfig:
      type: object
      description: 自定义节点配置参数
      properties:
        node_name:
          type: string
          description: 节点名称标识
        node_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - code
            - plugin
            - metadata
          description: 节点类型分类
        description:
          type: string
          description: 节点功能描述
        programming_language:
          type: string
          enum:
            - python
            - javascript
            - typescript
          description: 编程语言类型
        code_content:
          type: string
          description: 节点代码内容
        configuration:
          type: object
          description: 节点配置信息
        dependencies:
          type: array
          description: 依赖项列表
          items:
            type: string

    EmergencyConfig:
      type: object
      description: 应急处理配置参数
      properties:
        emergency_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - low
            - medium
            - high
            - critical
            - level1
            - level2
            - level3
            - level4
          description: 应急事件级别
        notification_contacts:
          type: array
          description: 紧急通知联系人列表
          items:
            type: string
            format: email
        recovery_strategy:
          type: string
          enum:
            - immediate
            - gradual
            - manual
          description: 系统恢复策略
        activation_reason:
          type: string
          description: 应急机制激活原因
        auto_recovery:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动恢复

    HeritageConfig:
      type: object
      description: 文化遗产数据处理配置
      properties:
        action_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - query
            - register
            - update
            - preserve
          description: 文化遗产操作类型
        heritage_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - intangible
            - tangible
            - cultural_practice
          description: 文化遗产类型
        heritage_category:
          type: string
          enum:
            - traditional_craft
            - performing_arts
            - rituals
            - oral_traditions
          description: 文化遗产分类
        heritage_data:
          type: object
          description: 文化遗产数据内容
        digital_assets:
          type: array
          description: 数字资产资源列表
          items:
            type: string
        cultural_context:
          type: object
          description: 文化背景信息
        location:
          type: string
          description: 文化遗产地理位置
        preservation_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - standard
            - premium
          description: 文化遗产保护级别
        processing_mode:
          type: string
          enum:
            - cataloging
            - digital_preservation
            - public_display
            - research
          description: 文化遗产处理模式
        luoyang_heritage_id:
          type: string
          description: 洛阳遗产ID
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: 用户请求

    IndustryConfig:
      type: object
      description: 行业分析配置参数
      properties:
        industry_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - manufacturing
            - retail
            - healthcare
            - finance
            - education
          description: 行业类型分类
        industry_name:
          type: string
          description: 行业名称标识
        analysis_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - classification
            - trends
            - competitive
            - risk
          description: 行业分析类型
        analysis_depth:
          type: string
          enum:
            - basic
            - standard
            - comprehensive
          description: 行业分析深度
        time_period:
          type: string
          description: 分析时间段
        forecast_period:
          type: string
          description: 行业预测周期
        include_forecast:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含预测分析
        include_trends:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含趋势分析
        comparison_metrics:
          type: array
          description: 行业比较指标
          items:
            type: string
        data_sources:
          type: array
          description: 行业数据来源
          items:
            type: string
        region:
          type: string
          description: 目标区域范围
        geographic_scope:
          type: string
          description: 地理分析范围
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: 用户请求

    PluginConfig:
      type: object
      description: 插件功能配置参数
      properties:
        plugin_description:
          type: string
          description: 插件功能描述
        node_types:
          type: array
          description: 支持的节点类型
          items:
            type: string
        execution_priority:
          type: string
          enum:
            - low
            - normal
            - high
            - critical
          description: 插件执行优先级
        self_healing_enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自愈功能
        trigger_conditions:
          type: object
          description: 插件触发条件

    QueryConfig:
      type: object
      description: 数据查询配置参数
      properties:
        page_number:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: 查询页码
        page_size:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 100
          description: 每页记录数
        sort_by:
          type: string
          enum:
            - name
            - created_date
            - modified_date
          description: 结果排序字段
        filter_by_status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - all
            - active
            - inactive
            - draft
          description: 状态过滤条件
        include_execution_history:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含执行历史
        include_node_details:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否包含节点详情

    RepairConfig:
      type: object
      description: 系统修复配置参数
      properties:
        repair_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - system
            - network
            - database
            - application
            - performance
          description: 修复类型分类
        repair_scope:
          type: string
          enum:
            - configuration
            - logic
            - dependencies
            - all
          description: 修复操作范围
        repair_strategy:
          type: string
          enum:
            - auto
            - semi_auto
            - manual_approval
          description: 修复策略选择
        diagnosis_mode:
          type: string
          enum:
            - quick
            - deep
            - predictive
          description: 诊断模式选择
        diagnosis_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - quick
            - standard
            - comprehensive
            - deep
            - predictive
          description: 问题诊断深度
        target_components:
          type: array
          description: 目标修复组件
          items:
            type: string
        auto_execute:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否自动执行修复
        backup_before_repair:
          type: boolean
          description: 修复前是否备份

    TrainingConfig:
      type: object
      description: 模型训练配置参数
      properties:
        model_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - classification
            - regression
            - clustering
            - nlp
          description: 机器学习模型类型
        model_target:
          type: string
          description: 模型训练目标
        training_data:
          type: string
          description: 训练数据内容
        training_dataset:
          type: string
          description: 训练数据集标识
        data_format:
          type: string
          enum:
            - json
            - csv
            - text
            - image
          description: 训练数据格式
        training_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 训练参数配置
        validation_split:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1
          description: 验证集分割比例
        data_quality_check:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否进行数据质量检查
        hyperparameter_tuning:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否进行超参数调优
        preprocessing:
          type: object
          description: 数据预处理配置

    ValidationConfig:
      type: object
      description: 参数验证配置
      properties:
        validation_rules:
          type: object
          description: 验证规则定义
        parameters_to_validate:
          type: object
          description: 待验证参数集合
        context:
          type: object
          description: 验证上下文信息
        strict_mode:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用严格验证模式
        auto_validate:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否自动验证参数
        error_handling:
          type: string
          enum:
            - strict
            - lenient
            - adaptive
          description: 错误处理策略
        validation_strictness:
          type: string
          enum:
            - relaxed
            - standard
            - strict
          description: 验证严格程度

  securitySchemes:
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: JWT Bearer Token认证
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
      description: API密钥认证
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: 使用JWT Bearer Token进行认证

security:
  - BearerAuth: []
  - ApiKeyAuth: []
  - bearerAuth: []
第八部分：完整参数配置表（60+参数汇总）
参数名称	类型	必填	默认值	所属模块	说明
user_request	string	是	-	SimpleRequest	用户自然语言需求描述
enable_automation	boolean	否	true	全局	是否启用自动化处理
automation_level	string	否	standard	全局	自动化处理级别（none/basic/standard/comprehensive/full）
operation_type	string	是	-	ProfessionalRequest	操作类型（30种枚举）
operation_config	object	是	-	ProfessionalRequest	操作配置参数
validation_config	object	否	{}	全局	验证配置
auto_validate	boolean	否	true	ValidationConfig	是否自动验证参数
validation_strictness	string	否	standard	ValidationConfig	验证严格程度（relaxed/standard/strict）
error_handling	string	否	adaptive	ValidationConfig	错误处理策略（strict/lenient/adaptive）
version	string	否	v1.0	全局	功能版本号（v1.0/v2.0/v3.0）
async_execution	boolean	否	false	全局	是否异步执行
callback_url	string	否	-	全局	异步回调URL
plugin_name	string	否	-	PluginConfig	插件名称
plugin_description	string	否	-	PluginConfig	插件描述
inputs	array	否	[]	PluginConfig	输入参数定义
outputs	array	否	[]	PluginConfig	输出参数定义
execution_priority	string	否	normal	PluginConfig	执行优先级（low/normal/high
